title: 1-2 Doctoral Researchers in literary studies or history / 1-2 Väitöskirjatutkijaa kirjallisuustieteessä tai historiassa (The Verses of Learning: Epideixis and the Cultural Stories of Nature at Early Modern Universities, VERSITAS project)
description:
Tampere University and Tampere University of Applied Sciences create a unique environment for multidisciplinary, inspirational, and high-impact research and education. Our universities community has its competitive edges in technology, health, and society. www.tuni.fi/en

[The Faculty of Social Sciences](https://www.tuni.fi/en/about-us/faculty-social-sciences) at Tampere University invites applications for

1-2 Doctoral Researchers in literary studies or history. The duration of employment is determined by the progress of the doctoral studies and thesis work and is limited up to a maximum of four years, starting in January 2027 or as agreed.

The positions are open within Academy Professor Sari Kivistös project, [The Verses of Learning: Epideixis and the Cultural Stories of Nature at Early Modern Universities (VERSITAS)](https://projects.tuni.fi/versitas/in-english/), funded by the Research Council of Finland (2026-2031). The project examines the relationships between poetry, rhetoric, and nature in the early modern period, as well as their roots and continuities in earlier and later centuries. Myths and cultural narratives were an important part of early modern natural history and shaped experiences of nature. The project argues that understanding nature from a cultural perspective requires attention to the literary forms, genres, and rhetorical strategies through which it was represented. Through the study of scientific writing and occasional literature from the early modern period and adjacent centuries, we investigate how literary and stylistic devices shape relationships between humans and nature. Based in the Faculty of Social Sciences at Tampere University, the project offers a supportive and inspiring working environment, as well as excellent opportunities for researchers to advance their skills and careers.

Positions and Qualifications

We are seeking promising doctoral researchers with a masters degree in a relevant field within the humanities (e.g., literary studies, rhetoric and its history, book history, intellectual history, or classical studies). Applicants will be assessed primarily on the suitability of their proposed research topic to the projects aims and its potential to produce research of high international standard. Knowledge of early modern literature and/or history, as well as experience working with historical texts and archival materials, will be considered an asset. Possible dissertation topics include historical studies of nature, human-animal studies, and ecocritical approaches to pre-modern and early modern literature, with potential scope for transhistorical perspectives. Familiarity with the history of rhetoric or occasional poetry will also be considered an advantage.

The doctoral researchers will be responsible for writing a doctoral dissertation related to the projects research themes and completing the credits required for the doctoral degree. They will collaborate with the research team in organizing joint events and participating in other academic activities. The appointed researchers will contribute to teaching and administrative duties for up to 5% of their working time.

The selected candidates must apply for and be admitted to Tampere Universitys [Doctoral Programme in Literary Studies](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/doctoral-programmes/doctoral-programme-literary-studies) or [Doctoral Programme in History](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/doctoral-programmes/doctoral-programme-history) during the autumn semester of 2026. The application period for these programmes runs from 1 to 30 October 2026.

We offer

The positions are fixed term for four years (or a shorter period, depending on the stage of the dissertation) and will begin in January 2027 or as agreed. A six-month trial period applies to all new employees at Tampere University.

Salary is based on [the University Salary System](https://www.sivista.fi/esittely/in-english/general-collective-agreement-for-universities/). Doctoral Researchers are placed on levels 2-4 of the salary scale. In addition to the basic salary, a performance-based salary component is paid according to the appointees qualifications and experience. The starting salary is approximately €2,700 per month and will increase as the doctoral studies progress.

The appointees are expected to reside in Finland during their employment at Tampere University. Tampere University is an internationally renowned research university offering a wide range of staff benefits, including occupational health care, flexible working hours, and excellent campus sports facilities. Please read more about [working at Tampere University](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us) and explore our [Career Stories.](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us/career-stories)

For more information about Tampere, please see [VisitTampere](https://visittampere.fi/en/). For further information about Finland, please visit [InfoFinland](https://www.infofinland.fi/)and [This is Finland](https://finland.fi/).

How to apply

Applications must be submitted in English through Tampere Universitys electronic recruitment system (link below). The closing date for applications is 11 September 2026 (at 23:59/UTC+3). Online interviews with shortlisted candidates will be held on 22 and 23 September 2026.

Please attach the following documents to your application:

1) CV (max. 3 pages, including a list of publications, if applicable, and the contact details of the supervisor of your masters thesis)

2) Reference letter from the prospective supervisor of the doctoral dissertation (if external to the research team)

3) Preliminary research proposal (max. 3 pages), including

- a description of your previous research experience (e.g., your masters thesis);
- a research idea outlining why the projects themes or approach interest you and how you would position your doctoral research within this context;
- a timeline for your doctoral studies.

Please be prepared to provide proof of your qualifications upon request. Please do not submit AI-generated research proposals.

Enquiries

For further information about the position, please contact the project PI, Academy Professor Sari Kivistö, sari.kivisto(at)tuni.fi.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Help Engineers Solve Real-World Technical Problems Across Europe from Porvoo, Finland**

At Thermetrics Europe, we support engineers, researchers, manufacturers, and technical organizations with precision thermal and moisture measurement technology, application expertise, service, calibration, and technical support.

We may be a young European company, but we are not starting from scratch. We have more than 40 years of Thermetrics technology, engineering experience, and industry knowledge behind us.

We're now building the next stage of Thermetrics Europe, and we're looking for a **Technical Support Engineer – Service & Support** to join our growing team in Porvoo, Finland (you must be already located in Southern Finland).

**The Role**

This is a hands-on, varied engineering role. You'll provide technical support to customers, assemble and test our products in Porvoo, travel throughout Europe for installations and service, troubleshoot equipment, perform calibrations, train customers, and help them get the most from their Thermetrics systems.

You'll also work closely with our engineering team in the US, bringing customer and field experience back into product development and continuous improvement. No two days will look exactly the same. You might be troubleshooting a system remotely in the morning, preparing equipment for shipping items in the afternoon, and traveling to a customer site the following week.

Travel is approximately **25% or less**, throughout Europe, occasionally including trips to outside Europe as well.

**Help Build the Support Team**

We're building our European support organization as we grow, which means this isn't a role where every process is already written and every responsibility has been neatly assigned. There will be trial and error, problem solving, and plenty of wearing different hats.

You'll have opportunities to help develop service procedures, documentation, customer support processes, training materials, and new ways of working. Sometimes you'll be doing the technical work. Sometimes you'll be helping figure out how the technical work should be done.

We're looking for someone who enjoys that kind of environment.

You don't need to know everything on day one. You do need to be curious, willing to learn, comfortable asking questions, and able to look at a problem and say: "We haven't done this before. Let's figure it out."

**Team Player. Independent Problem Solver.**

You'll be part of a small, collaborative team, but field service also requires you to be comfortable working independently.

When you're at a customer site, you may be the technical person in the room. You'll need to assess the situation, troubleshoot on the go, make good decisions, communicate clearly, and keep working toward a solution even when conditions aren't perfect.

We're looking for someone who:

- Works well as part of a small team.

- Can work independently in the field.

- Enjoys hands-on troubleshooting and problem solving.

- Stays calm when things don't go according to plan.

- Takes ownership of problems and follows them through to resolution.

- Knows when to solve a problem independently and when to reach out for help.

- Is willing to pitch in wherever needed as the company grows.

- Communicates well with both technical and non-technical customers.


**What You'll Bring**

**Required:**

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Physics, or a related technical field.

- At least 2 years of experience with scientific instrumentation, laboratory equipment, automated equipment, engineered products, field service, commissioning, or technical support.

- Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- A practical, hands-on approach to technical problem solving.

- Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% internationally, mostly alone

- Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative international team.

- Native or professional working proficiency in English.

- Valid Driver's License


**Nice to have:**

- Experience with scientific instrumentation or laboratory equipment.

- Experience with thermal, environmental, textile, or PPE testing.

- Experience with calibration, validation, commissioning, or field service.

- Familiarity with SolidWorks, Python, Excel, Power BI, or similar tools.

- Finnish or Swedish language skills.


**Why Thermetrics Europe?**

title: Buyer
description:

title: Secondary Engineer
description:
At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as hydrogen, data centers and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

**The Opportunity**

We are offering a position as a Secondary Engineer at Hitachi Energy, Grid Integration business. This role will be in Vaasa, where we have the team and an office.

The business unit designs and delivers complete substations for distribution and transmission grids. We are offering an interesting position in an international project environment and various development possibilities in the areas of design and engineering, research, and development. Because each project is different, your responsibilities will range widely and may include managing all aspects of secondary design from initial planning to final delivery.

Daily responsibilities include preparing design drawings, drafting essential construction documents, conducting engineering calculations, and overseeing commissioning processes. At Hitachi Energy, you will have the opportunity to apply your design expertise across diverse projects, both domestically in Finland and internationally.

**How You'll Make an Impact**

- Prepare and review substation documentations, for example, single line diagram, protection diagrams, interlocking diagrams, AC and DC drawings, calculations, control and protection panel drawings, IED configurations, cabling and bills of materials.

- Provide technical evaluation of supplier proposals and accepts as fit for purpose supplied equipment or services.

- Provide technical support during pre-FAT and FAT stage, handling installation and commissioning activities. Prepare project documentation within one's scope of deliverables.

- Participate in testing and commissioning.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including project manager, design (Lead, Primary, Civil and commissioning), planner, quality assurance, and supply chain, to ensure seamless project integration and successful outcomes in international project environment.

- Drive a culture of continuous improvement, fostering innovation, and encouraging employee involvement in problem-solving and process enhancement.

- Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues, and the business.


**Your background**

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering.

- Proficiency in both spoken and written English and Finnish or Swedish.

- Demonstrated proactivity, results orientation, strong interpersonal and teamwork abilities.

- Willingness to participate in international projects.

- Willingness to travel up to 20%, both domestically and internationally.

- Previous experience in engineering work related to high and medium voltage substations is considered an asset.

- Experience in design software such as E3, AutoCAD, PCM600 is considered as an advantage.

- Understanding of substation control and protection systems is also considered beneficial.

title: Cleaner – Winter Season in Lapland Rovaniemi
description:
We are looking for a **reliable and active part-time cleaner** to join our team for the winter season in Rovaniemi. The job starts at the **beginning of November 2026 and continues until the end of March 2027**.

The work is varied and you will work in different locations around Rovaniemi. Our customers include **local businesses, Airbnb apartments and other holiday accommodation**. Sometimes you may also help at our laundry.

Working days can be **any day from Monday to Sunday, including weekends**. Working hours can change depending on the day, but most shifts are between **8:00 and 18:00**.

We are looking for someone who enjoys active and varied work. You should be able to work independently, take responsibility for your work and notice what needs to be done.

Your tasks include

- cleaning Airbnb apartments and other accommodation

- cleaning local businesses and other work spaces

- helping at our laundry when needed


The locations and tasks can be different every day. The most important thing is to make sure that every place is **clean, tidy and ready for the next guest or customer**.

What we expect from you

- a positive and active attitude

- careful and good-quality work

- ability to work independently

- ability to work on weekdays and weekends


A driving licence and the ability to drive a manual car are **required for this job**, because you will drive between different locations during the working day.

**Previous cleaning experience is a plus**, especially if you have worked with Airbnb apartments, hotels or business cleaning before. However, experience is not everything. A good attitude, willingness to learn and taking responsibility for your work are very important to us.

**English skills are a plus.**

Most of the time you will work independently, but sometimes you will also work together with other team members.

What we offer

- a job for the full winter season, from **November 2026 until the end of March 2027**

- different tasks and working days

- training before you start working independently

- a friendly and supportive team


Interested?

We are looking for someone who is **reliable, active and ready to work**. If you like varied work and enjoy seeing the results of your work, this could be a good job for you.

Please tell us briefly about yourself and your previous work experience in your application. We will review applications during the application period, so please send your application as soon as possible.

title: Vastaanoton vuoropäällikkö / Sunday Morning Resort, Pyhätunturi, Lappi, Suomi
description:
Monipuolinen vastaanottotyö tarjolla boutique-hotellissa Pyhätunturilla upeassa Lapin ympäristössä! Oletko sinä tiimimme puuttuva palanen?

**Työn kuvaus**

Haemme nyt vastaanoton vuoropäällikköä vahvistamaan tiimiämme Pyhätunturille, Sunday Morning Resortiin. Meillä tunturien hiljaisuus kohtaa huippuluokan palvelun.

Vastaanottomme on kaiken toiminnan sydämessä, joten tässä roolissa pääset osallistumaan monipuolisesti resort-kohteen toimintaan. **Toivomme sinulta vähintään kahden vuoden/sesongin mittaista kokemusta vastaanottotyöskentelystä tai vastaavasta asemasta eri aloilta.** Meillä monipuolisuus on rikkaus ja arvostamme erilaisia taustoja.

Vastaanottovirkailijan työtehtäviin kuuluvat monipuoliset asiakaspalvelutehtävät. Huolehdimme asiakkaistamme lämpimästi niin vastaanottotiskillä, sähköpostitse, puhelimitse kuin eri varauskanavienkin kautta. Vastaanoton perustehtäviin kuuluvat mm.

- Sisään- ja uloskirjaukset (Sunday Morning Resort & Parkside Pyhä)

- Majoitus- ja ohjelmapalveluvarausten hallinta (järjestelmien tarkistus, että esim. ohjelmapalvelut ja pöytävaraukset ovat täsmällisesti merkattu, tervetulokirjeiden teko, paikallisten aktiviteettien suosittelua ja esittelyä)

- Majoitus- ja ohjelmapalveluvarausten maksuista huolehtiminen (ennakkomaksut ja paikan päällä rahastus)

- Lisäpalveluiden myynti ja varausten teko

- OTA-kanavien varaushallinta, asiakasviestintä & lisämyynti

- (meillä käytössä Booking.com & Expedia Group)

- Läheinen ja saumaton yhteistyö eri osastojen välillä

- Vastaanoton yhteydessä toimivan pienen matkamuistomyymälän tuotteiden esillepanosta ja myynnistä huolehtiminen + kahvipisteen siisteydestä huolehtiminen

- Concierge/guest relations -työntekijän tuuraus tarvittaessa (uusi toimenkuva tulevalle talvikaudelle, sis. mm. lobby-barista ja huonetoimituksista huolehtiminen)

- Lisäksi avustat tarvittaessa esim. kokouspalveluissa tai siivouksessa.


**Vastaanoton vuoropäällikön tehtäviin kuuluvat lisäksi:**

- Vastaanoton sujuvan arjen varmistaminen yhdessä esihenkilön kanssa

- Vastuu päivän tapahtumista ja korkeasta palvelusta

- Maksujen tarkistus & järjestelmien päivitys

- Viikkotilitysten tarkistus

- Ryhmävarausten valmistelut

- Vastaanoton esihenkilön avustaminen hallinnollisissa tehtävissä tarpeen ja osaamisesi mukaan


Tiimisi koostuu 2- 3 vastaanottovirkailijasta/-vuoropäälliköstä, concierge/guest relations -työntekijästä sekä vastaanoton esihenkilöstä. Resortimme koon ollessa kompakti, toimimme lähtökohtaisesti vuoroissa itsenäisesti sesonkiaikojen huiput poislukien. Toivomme siis vastuullista otetta työntekoon, jossa vuorossa eteentulevat asiat hoidetaan rauhallisesti ja huolellisesti. Apu on kuitenkin aina lähellä ja perehdyspäivien aikana käymme resortin ja vastaanoton toiminnot huolellisesti läpi.

Toimimme tiiviissä yhteistyössä muiden osastojen (resortin johto, myynti, keittiö & ravintola, siivous, ohjelmapalvelut, huolto) kanssa laadukkaan palvelun varmistamiseksi. Lisäksi meillä on vastaanotossa työparina tekoälypohjainen assistentti Butler AI, jonka kautta osa asiakasviestinnästämme hoituu. Työssäsi pääset myös kehittämään ja kouluttamaan Butleria aina vain paremmaksi asiakaspalvelijaksi.

**Toivomme sinulta:**

- Soveltuvaa koulutusta (esim. hotellivirkailija, restonomi tms.) ja / tai työkokemusta vastaavasta työstä

- Aiempi kokemus hotellivarausjärjestelmistä on eduksi, muttei pakollinen. Perehdytämme sinut mielellämme myös järjestelmiin. Meillä käytössä ovat:

- Mews (majoitusvaraukset),

- Fareharbour (aktiviteetti- ja kuljetusvaraukset),

- ResDiary (ravintolavaraukset) sekä

- Profitroom (verkkosivusto ja Booking Engine).

- Lämminhenkistä palveluasennetta

- Kykyä työskennellä vastuuntuntoisesti sekä tiimin jäsenenä että yksin työvuoroissa

- Kykyä työskennellä tapahtumien keskipisteessä tyylikkään asiakaspalvelun säilyttäen monien asioiden tapahtuessa usein samanaikaisesti —> priorisointitaidot plussaa!

- Joustavuutta ja hyviä ongelmanratkaisukykyjä

- Sujuvaa suomen- ja englanninkielen taitoa - asiakkaamme saapuvat meille eri puolilta maailmaa. Muut kielet ovat plussaa, muttei pakollisia.

- Hygieniapassi ja anniskelupassi katsotaan eduksi

- Tärkeimpänä pidämme kuitenkin ennakkoluulotonta ja rohkeaa asennetta, kaiken voi aina oppia ja tässä tiimissä opimmekin yhdessä toinen toisiltamme.


**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen työn, jossa saat yhdistää asiakaspalvelun, myynnin ja majoituspalveluiden tehtäviä

- Mukavan, ammattitaitoisen ja tiiviin tiimin tuen sekä ainutlaatuisen työympäristön Pyhän tunturimaisemissa

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi matkailu- ja majoitusalalla

- Työpaikan erinomaisella sijainnilla lähellä Pyhätunturin palveluita ja laskettelukeskusta

- Mahdollisuuden työntekijämajoitukseen edullisella vuokralla.

- Kattavan työterveyshuollon

- Yrityksellä 2 kpl Pyhän yrityskausikortteja käytettävissä laskettelusta innostuneille

- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä kestävän matkailun yrityksessä, joka on sertifioitu Sustainable Travel Finland -merkillä

- Mahdollisuuden osallistua kasvavan yrityksen kehittämistyöhön. Parannamme jatkuvasti tekemistämme henkilöstöltä ja asiakkailta saadun palautteen mukaan.


**Työsuhde**

Paikkoja on tarjolla yksi, kokoaikainen 37,5/h/vk eli 112,5/3vk. Aloitus marraskuun puolivälissä. Työsuhteen kesto arviolta maaliskuun puoleenväliin.

**Meistä**

Sunday Morning Collection tarjoaa korkeatasoisia aktiviteetteja ja elämyksiä Pyhä-Luoston kansallispuistossa. Talvikaudella järjestämme muun muassa sähkömoottorikelkkaretkiä, revontulielämyksiä, lumikenkäretkiä, pilkkiretkiä, farmivierailuja sekä muita luontoaktiviteetteja.

Sunday Morning Collectioniin kuuluvat myös Sunday Morning Resort, Parkside Pyhä lomahuoneistot sekä Ravintola Aihki. Yhdessä luomme vieraillemme aitoja, vastuullisia ja korkeatasoisia Lapin elämyksiä.

title: CNC-koneistaja / CNC-machinist
description:
CNC-koneistaja – Pohjois-Savo / CNC-Machinist, North-Savo, Finland

Etsimme asiakkaallemme CNC-koneistajaa Pohjois-Savoon Kaaville vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Asiakkaamme valmistaa koneistettuja komponentteja mm metsä- ja kaivosteollisuuden koneisiin, kuten polttoaine- ja hydrauliikkasäiliöihin. Tuotanto on monipuolista ja valmistettavien kappaleiden koko vaihtelee – tuotannossa on sekä pieniä sarjoja että yksittäisiä kappaleita.


Työtehtävät

Työskentelet monipuolisesti CNC-koneistuksen parissa. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

* CNC-koneiden käyttö ja asetukset
* kappaleiden koneistus teknisten piirustusten ja mitoitusvaatimusten mukaisesti
* työkalujen ja työstöarvojen määrittäminen
* kappaleiden mittaus ja laadun varmistaminen
* koneiden asetusten ja työkalujen vaihtaminen
* tarvittaessa useamman koneen samanaikainen käyttö

Kaikissa koneissa ohjelmointi ja koneistus perustuvat ISO-/G-koodiin.


Työstökoneet ovat vaaka- ja pystykaraisia. Ohjaimina Haas, Fanuc ja Mazatrol. Työstökoneiden lisäksi osaaminen sorvilla eduksi (Y-akselillisista CNC-sorveista, vastakarasta, tankolaitteista).


Odotamme sinulta

* vähintään 2 vuoden työkokemusta CNC-koneistuksesta
* kokemusta CNC-työstökeskuksista (osaaminen sorveista eduksi)
* ISO-/G-koodin hallintaa
* kykyä lukea teknisiä piirustuksia
* mittavälineiden sujuvaa käyttöä
* huolellista ja itsenäistä työskentelyotetta
* valmiutta työskennellä 2-vuorossa
* hyvää työmotivaatiota ja halua kehittyä koneistajana
* Fanuc-, Haas- ja/tai Mazatrol-ohjausten tuntemus


Tarjoamme

* vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työsuhteen
* työajan 40 h/vko, 2-vuorotyössä
* palkkauksen teknologiateollisuuden työehtosopimuksen mukaan, alkaen 14,87 €/h brutto + vuorolisät
* mahdollisuuden työaikapankin hyödyntämiseen
* edullisen työasunnon mahdollisuuden
* monipuolisen ja nykyaikaisen konekannan
* mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamista ja työskennellä erilaisten CNC-koneiden parissa

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

Jos olet kokenut CNC-koneistaja ja haluat työskennellä monipuolisessa tuotantoympäristössä, lähetä meille hakemuksesi!
**



CNC Machinist – North Savo

We are looking for an experienced CNC Machinist for our client in Kaavi,North Savo, Finland.

Our client manufactures machined components for the forestry and mining industries, including fuel and hydraulic tanks. Production is varied, with different component sizes and both small batches and individual pieces.

The workplace is located approximately 60 km from Kuopio.


Your responsibilities

Your work will include a wide range of CNC machining tasks, such as:

* operating and setting CNC machines
* machining components according to technical drawings and specified dimensions
* setting tools and machining parameters
* measuring components and ensuring quality
* changing tools and making machine adjustments
* operating several machines simultaneously when required

All machines are operated using ISO/G-code.


Horizontal and vertical Machining centres, with Haas, Fanuc- and Mazatrol controllers. Experience with CNC Lathes is advantage (Y-axis CNC lathes, sub-spindles, bar feeders)


What we expect from you

* at least 2 years of experience in CNC machining
* experience with machining centres (experience with CNC lathes is advantage)
* good knowledge of ISO/G-code
* ability to read and understand technical drawings
* ability to use measuring tools
* accurate and independent working style
* willingness to work in a 2-shift system
* good motivation and willingness to develop your machining skills
* Knowledge of Fanuc, Haas and/or Mazatrol controls


We offer

* a permanent, full-time employment contract
* working hours of 40 hours/week in a 2-shift system
* salary according to the Technology Industry Collective Agreement, starting from €14.87/hour gross + shift allowances
* possibility to use a working time bank
* affordable work-related accommodation
* a modern and versatile machine park
* an opportunity to develop your skills and work with a wide range of CNC machines

The work can start as soon as possible, according to agreement.

If you are an experienced CNC Machinist looking for a versatile position with modern CNC equipment, send us your application!

title: Night receptionist, Star Arctic Hotel, Saariselkä, Lapland
description:
Are you the night receptionist we are looking for?

The Star Arctic Hotel is uniquely situated on the top of Kaunispää fell, surrounded by the pristine Arctic wilderness and the breathtaking landscapes of a national park. It offers premium accommodation in spectacular suites, where you can stay above the clouds and experience the peace and beauty of Finnish Lapland at its finest. Carefully curated full-service holiday packages make your stay effortless, while a wide range of activities ensures unforgettable experiences for every guest. The panoramic Restaurant Kaunis serves culinary delights inspired by the pure nature of Lapland, both in the dining room and at the bar. End your evening in the cozy lounge bar, relaxing by the warmth of the fireplace. The hotel's motto, Passion for Lapland, is reflected in every aspect of the guest experience.

We are looking for professional night receptionist for the winter season 2026–2027!

As a night receptionist, you will work while others are sleeping. Your diverse responsibilities include guest check-ins and check-outs for high-quality accommodation, processing reports, providing customer service, and preparing for the following day. During your shift, you will work independently and be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of the hotel throughout the night. We are looking for candidates with previous front desk experience, an independent approach to work, and fluent English language skills. You will work as part of international team - Finnish language skills are not required.

Full-time employment, 90h/3 weeks, starts with orientation in Mid-November 2026 and lasts til March-April 2027. Terms of employment are following the Finnish Collective agreement for hotel- and restaurant industry. Salary according to the agreement. Employment contract will be between Bondata and employee. Shared accommodation in Saariselkä will be organized by the company for a reasonable rent.

What we offer:

- Unique work place on top of Kaunispää fell

- Good orientation for the work tasks and support from your team

- Possibility to develop your professional skills

- Bondata support during your employment

- Shared accommodation with your own bedroom for a reasonable rent

We hope from you:

- Suitable education / good previous work experience of night receptionist tasks

- Excellent team working skills

- Ability to work independently and under pressure

- Familiarity with the Mews and FareHarbor systems is considered an advantage.

- Fluent english language, other languages are an advantage

- B-driving lisence and own car are an advantage in this area

Salary:

Salary according to the collective agreement for the hotel- and restaurant industry, taking into account relevant experience in the field.

Recruitment process:

Please send your application with your resume in English as soon as possible. We will start video interviews instantly, so remember check your emails during recruitment process!

More info:
Bondata Lapland
Lappi@bondata.fi


Star Arctic Hotel

Established in early 2016, this privately owned Star Arctic hotel offers high-quality accommodation and exceptional service in the heart of Lapland's breathtaking fell landscape. Stunning views of the surrounding fells can be enjoyed from the hotel's main building as well as from every guest room. During the winter season, guests have the opportunity to admire the magical Northern Lights directly from the hotel, creating an unforgettable Arctic experience.

The hotel's philosophy is built on providing comfortable accommodation, outstanding customer service, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Its peaceful location and close proximity to nature make it an ideal destination for both relaxation and unforgettable adventures in Finnish Lapland.

title: HSE Specialist
description:
At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as data centers, hydrogen and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

We are looking for a HSE Specialist to join our HSE Team in Vaasa, Finland. In this role, you will support our Finnish projects in the Nordic Operation Unit (OU) and focus on the HSE tasks in the HSE department and throughout the projects life cycle. You will be ensuring that the highest standards of health, safety and environmental performance are documented, monitored and maintained. You will also be driving continuous improvement in all areas of HSE.

The Nordic OU HSE Team is a network of experienced health, safety and environmental professionals supporting the delivery of complex construction, energy and industrial projects across Finland, Sweden and Denmark. We support highly skilled site teams in delivering world-class projects through professionalism, quality and operational excellence, creating environments where safety is the natural outcome of doing the job right. Working closely with project management, customers and contractors, we provide expertise and practical support throughout the project lifecycle. Our focus is on enabling disciplined planning, effective risk management and high-quality execution that protects people, enhances performance and strengthens project outcomes.

Our strength lies in our people. We bring together talented professionals with experience from the energy sector, industrial construction and major infrastructure projects. We value expertise, integrity and a willingness to take initiative. We are a team that shares knowledge openly, learns from each other and works together to solve challenges in demanding project environments. We welcome individuals from diverse professional backgrounds who are motivated by continuous development and a desire to make a meaningful impact.

We believe that excellence comes from combining technical competence with personal accountability. We encourage constructive challenge, transparent communication and the confidence to speak up when improvements can be made. By maintaining high professional standards and supporting one another, we help project teams achieve results while protecting people, the environment and the long-term success of our projects.

We challenge established practices and continuously look for better ways to manage risk, support project teams and improve performance. Through innovation, digitalization and intelligent use of technology, we advance how decisions are made and how projects are executed. We do not simply adapt to change; we actively shape the future of HSE by turning new ideas into practical solutions that enable safer, smarter and more efficient project delivery.

If you are motivated by complex projects, enjoy working with skilled professionals and want to help shape the future of HSE in the energy and construction industries, you will fit right in with our team.

**How you'll make an impact**

- Implement and work with continuous improvement of Hitachi Energy operating unit management system and local requirements in Finland for the operating unit of the Nordic OU.

- Prepare and update HSE documentation in accordance with the internal process. Submit all preliminary HSE plans to the customer in accordance with the tender submission dates.

- Attend clarification meetings and workshops with the customer (both in person and remotely).

- Prepare the Project HSE Plan as well as other HSE-related documentation such as the Emergency Preparedness and Response Plan.

- Ensure activities under the scope of Hitachi Energy are in compliance with legal and contractual HSE requirements as well as internal HSE requirements.

- Produce reports for Project Reviews, both internal and customer, and attend the Project Review meetings to ensure the Hitachi Energy HSE Operating System remains suitable, adequate, and effective.

- Review HSE documentation from all Hitachi Energy subcontractors and support subcontractors to meet internal and Project HSE requirements.


**Your background**

- Previous experience of HSE tasks in projects

- Professional HSE certification is seen as a plus

- Knowledge of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 certifications

- Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to operate within global teams

- Self-driven and persistent attitude towards challenges. You work actively and professionally both independently and as a part of a team.

- Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English and Finnish. Swedish is seen as a plus.

title: Senior Project Planner
description:
At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as data centers, hydrogen and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

Hitachi Energy is looking for a Senior Project Planner to join our Project Controls team within the Nordic Operating Unit of our Grid Integration business. The position is based in Vaasa, Finland or Västerås, Sweden, with hybrid working possibilities.

As a Senior Project Planner, you will play a critical role throughout the entire lifecycle of our most complex electrical substation projects, from tendering to project handover in the field of planning and scheduling. Your expertise and proactive approach will ensure consistency and alignment of scope, time, cost, and progress, ultimately contributing to the success and satisfaction of our customers.

In this role, you will be in the driving seat, ensuring projects have robust, dynamic, and well-structured schedules that meet contractual objectives and provide clear roadmaps for the execution phase.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust, dynamic project schedules that align with contractual commitments and provide a clear framework for successful project execution.

You will work closely with various stakeholders making sure the project schedules are used for work coordination, predictable forecasting, proactive schedule risk management, cost management, resource management, and of course, team alignment. You will also conduct schedule and resource analysis and prepare schedule progress reporting materials both for external and internal purposes.

At Hitachi Energy, we know that great results are achieved together. As a Senior Project Planner, you will collaborate closely with Project Managers, Project Controllers, Lead Engineers, Project SCMs, Logistic Specialists, Site and Commissioning Managers and with our Customers. You will also become part of a highly experienced and supportive community of Project Planners. Together, we share knowledge, solve challenges, and support one another in delivering excellence in every project.

**How you'll make an impact**

· Take a leading role in planning and scheduling activities in complex projects and support project teams with schedule governance, analysis and decision making

· Develop, maintain, and analyze integrated project schedules in close collaboration with project teams

· Support predictable schedule forecasting by aligning time, cost, resources and progress

· Identify schedule deviations, risks, and opportunities early, and communicate them clearly to project stakeholders

· Prepare schedule reports and analyses, including S-curves, critical path analyses, resource histograms and On-Time-Delivery (OTD) milestones

· Actively communicate schedule information to stakeholders to keep everyone informed

· Support and prepare What-if schedule scenarios, delay mitigation plans and Extension of Time (EoT) claims together with the project team

· Promote planning and scheduling best practices across the organization, act as a role model and support less experienced planners

· Drive the use and continuous improvement of planning and scheduling methodologies and tools

**Your background**

· M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Electrical engineering or another relevant field

· Proven experience in planning and scheduling complex projects

· Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage, motivate, and inspire stakeholders across the project organization

· Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 and good knowledge of schedule management theory

· The ability to prepare and maintain high quality, dynamic project schedules together with the project team

· A proactive and self-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

· A structured and goal-oriented approach to your work, with a focus on delivering results

· Project Management Certificate (PMP® and/or PMI-SP®) is considered an advantage

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; knowledge of Finnish and/or Swedish is considered a plus

title: Christmas Operations Coordinator, Lapland Safaris Saariselkä
description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Christmas Operations Coordinators for the Christmas season 2026 in Saariselkä and Rovaniemi.**

The duties focus on handling and organizing the safari programs for charter flight travelers. The coordinators form a team who manage the Christmas Operations as a whole, with the operators daily schedule being its core. This includes, for example, transportation scheduling, cooperation with tour operators, and management of bookings for various safaris with our suppliers. The Christmas Operations Coordinator mainly works as part of a team, but must also be capable of independent work, and if necessary, also acts as a guide.

We expect you to have an active and energetic attitude, a suitable education, and previous work experience within the tourism field in Lapland, as well as a flexible and firm approach to handling tasks. Excellent interpersonal skills are required as you will be guiding other team members in their work. December is a very busy travel month, so we also hope for problem-solving ability and the ability to work under pressure. The work environment is international, so you must have fluent verbal and written English skills. Knowledge of Finnish language is a big advantage in this position. Other language skills and previous experience in guiding work and providing tourism services are considered an advantage.

**In Saariselkä** the work is carried out in two different teams depending on the tour operator. In this role, you act as a key link between the tour operator and the transport company, ensuring smooth cooperation between all parties. You are also responsible for efficiently communicating last-minute changes to subcontractors and partners. The role involves active communication both internally and externally, including communication with subcontractors and the tour operator using various systems. Success in this position requires excellent communication skills, strong IT skills and the ability to understand and manage overall operational processes.

**In Rovaniemi** the work is carried out in two different teams depending on the tour operator. You are responsible for the overall logistics across the different components of the travel package, including group planning, daily operational execution, cooperation with subcontractors, and invoicing. You are also responsible for maintaining and updating the ERP system, which makes strong IT skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications essential for this role. You are not expected to know everything on your own, as you will always have the support of a strong team behind you.

A drivers license is required in Rovaniemi, and in Saariselkä it is considered an advantage.

**We offer you:**

- The support of a professional work team and an interesting job description

- Lapland's natural beautiful surroundings

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides new employees with paid, role-specific training at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will start in October/November 2026 and last until the beginning/mid of January 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade B-C, hourly wage starting at 12,20 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

More information: info@laplandstaff.fi

title: Christmas Operations Coordinator, Lapland Safaris Ylläs
description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Christmas Operations Coordinators for the Christmas season 2026 in Ylläs and Levi.**

The duties of Christmas Operations Coordinator focus on handling and organizing the daily operations for Christmas charter flight travellers. Depending on your specific role within the team, these tasks may include transportation scheduling, cooperation with tour operator personnel, supervising the active Elf Guide team and the management of bookings for our own Safaris and with external suppliers.

We require fluent English Language skills, as you will need to communicate with the whole Lapland Safaris team, tour operator personnel and international guests. Although not mandatory, knowledge of the Finnish Language would be a big advantage for this role, especially because contacting external suppliers is a common task.

**In Levi and Ylläs** we are looking for people to fill the following positions:

**Elf Guide shift supervisors:**

You will work as the supervisor for the elf team and are responsible for the smooth running of the daily Christmas operations. You will understand the many aspects of the elves' work; co-ordinate their working day transfers, monitor their shifts and that the working hour markings are correct.

The best supervisors are able to think fast, work well under pressure and can quickly react to solve problems. Situations can occur for several reasons and in short notice we need to find solutions. Willingness to jump in the elf role is advantage, as short notice replacements are often filled by supervisors. Therefore, experience of entertainment, acting or dance background, or someone who has previously worked as an elf is seen as an advantage.

**Optional Sales team members:**

Excursions and safaris sold by tour operator representatives to their own customers are offered as an add-on to the holiday packages of guests. These optional programs are a large part of our Christmas operations. Team members make the pre-booked reservations to ERP system and assist the reps with daily on-site sales and bookings. Daily task also includes managing allotments of excursions, communicating with suppliers and handling the liquidation of sales at the end of each day. Previous experience of working with computers and different online systems is expected and excellent knowledge of Excel. be Previous experience of working as cashier is seen as an advantage. Sales team members are expected to be precise and enthusiastic with the ability to work under pressure during hectic on-site sales times.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, systems and structured processes in a fast-paced operational environment. Data Coordinator is responsible for managing and processing all operational data related to daily excursions. This includes creating accurate guest name lists, bus allocation lists and ensuring all information is correctly prepared and shared with other team members. Close collaboration with team is essential to ensure smooth daily operations. A key part of the role is maintaining and updating ERP system, including preparing data for invoicing once guest groups have returned home. Excellent computer skills are required with strong pruriency in Microsoft Excel and a high level of digital confidence. Accuracy, reliability and the ability to work independently with large amounts of information are essential for success in this role.

Your role includes being on site at the activity locations, as well as coordinating specified bus arrivals and departures at Kittilä (KTT) Airport on arrival and departure days. Strong communication and group management skills are essential, as you will supervise a large team of elf guides and ensure that all activities run safely and on schedule. You will also cooperate with bus company and tour operators representatives. Your administrative work is crucial to creating a successful experience for guests.

title: Snowmobile Sleigh Driver, Lapland Safaris Saariselkä
description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Snowmobile Sleigh drivers for Lapland Safaris Saariselkä, for the Christmas season 2026.**

The main task of a Snowmobile Sleigh driver is to act as a driver pulling a sleigh full of guests with a snowmobile. Sleigh drivers work outside in Christmas-themed activity areas, spreading joy and transporting international Christmas groups,mainly consisting of families. The work is independent, but there are several other drivers in the same area, so the work is done as part of a larger team.

Duties also include providing clothing to our guests, as well as clothing maintenance.Your working day may include preparation tasks for the activity area and possibly dismantling and cleaning the activity area after the program ends, together with a team consisting of activity and safari guides and sleigh drivers.

The length of working days varies according to the group and program. The work is done both on weekdays and on weekends, also on Christmas holidays, and the days can be long. We value flexibility in working hours and good pressure tolerance.

Your journey as a Lapland Safaris Sleigh Driver will be facilitated by an active and brisk attitude and a good ability to communicate both with the team and guests. title: Early Childhood Education Teacher, Daycare Aurinkokello, North Sámi-speaking group, Keski-Pasila
description:
We are looking for an Early Childhood Education Teacher for Aurinkokellos North Sámi-speaking group!

A wonderful new daycare centre, Aurinkokello, has been completed in Keski-Pasila, and operations began in August 2025. Early childhood education and pre-primary education services are being introduced gradually in the new unit. The position can also be performed on a part-time basis.

Suotnjarat is a sibling group for children aged 2-6 with a teacher and a carer working as a team. The group follows both the Helsinki Early Childhood Education Plan and the Sámi Early Childhood Education Plan. The goal of Sámi-language early childhood education is to support the childs growth into an independent, responsible, and social individual, as well as to foster the development of their language skills.

A childs proficiency in both languages becomes strong when they follow the immersion path throughout their entire educational journey up to the end of basic education. The group collaborates regularly with both a Finnish-language pre-primary education group and the Sámi class at Pasila Comprehensive School, providing pre-primary-aged children with opportunities to meet and engage in shared activities with children from other pre-primary groups.

Aurinkokello operates in the same building as Pasila Comprehensive School, enabling excellent cooperation along the childs educational path and the natural shared use of facilities. The daycare centre is very easy to reach, with excellent tram, bus, train and cycling connections.


What do we expect from you?

We hope that your work demonstrates strong basic pedagogical skills in everyday practice and a sensitive approach to meeting children. We expect you to understand the importance of play in a childs development and learning. You recognize that play is part of the adults responsibilities, you are a playful adult, and you make use of playfulness in various everyday situations. The facilities and learning materials at Aurinkokello are designed to invite play, so we expect you, as an adult, to take responsibility for continuously shaping and developing the play environment.

At Aurinkokello, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary team. We hope you have the motivation and attitude to develop practices in a new environment and within an evolving operational culture. You are open to experimenting with your team and suggesting changes that support a smooth and positive everyday experience for both children and adults. The daycare centre director and assistant director provide strong pedagogical support to the staff and are committed to creating the conditions that enable employees to succeed in their work.

Interested? If Aurinkokello sounds like your next workplace, don't wait - send us your application today. We will personally contact all candidates selected for an interview.

Hitta även denna platsannons på svenska och finska.
Löydät tämän työpaikkailmoituksen myös suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.

As an Early Childhood Education Teacher, you will be responsible for building the operational culture and learning environment of your child group, as well as planning, implementing, developing, and evaluating pedagogical activities. You will also support each childs individual learning in accordance with the Helsinki Early Childhood Education and Pre-primary Education Curriculum, the units operational plan, and the childs individual early childhood education plan.

Why Join Us?

It is important to us that you are able to do meaningful work that contributes to a good life for everyone in Helsinki. We want you to succeed and feel inspired in your work. We offer a wide range of opportunities for professional growth and development. According to our latest staff survey, our employees enjoy working here and find their work meaningful.

You will have access to the employee benefits offered by Finlands largest employer, including support for commuting costs and up to 550 euros in annual benefits for culture, sports, and well-being. Read more about our employee benefits and learn about the City of Helsinki as an employer at: hel.fi/en/open-jobs/why-work-for-the-city.
Staff housing: Staff housing units located across the city that you can apply for.

If you begin a permanent employment as as a teacher in Sámi-language early childhood education with the City of Helsinki in 2026, we will offer you a 3000 € recruitment incentive bonus. The bonus is paid only once per person. For further information, please contact the recruiting Daycare Centre Director.


Qualification requirements:

We require that you hold the qualification required under the Finnish Early Childhood Education and Care Act (540/2018), or, in accordance with the transitional provision (Section 75), a Bachelor's degree in Education qualifying you as an early childhood education teacher, a relevant University of Applied Sciences degree, or a corresponding former college-level qualification, such as a kindergarten teacher or social educator qualification (Act 272/2005 and Decree 608/2005). Eligibility may also be demonstrated through a recognition decision issued by the Finnish National Agency for Education, confirming that your foreign qualification provides eligibility for the position.

The main working language of the position is North Sámi. Good spoken proficiency in North Sámi is required. In addition, applicants must have good spoken and written proficiency in either Finnish, Swedish, or English. Proficiency in Finnish is considered an asset. In the absence of qualified applicants, candidates with developing North Sámi language skills will also be considered.

A person hired must submit an extract from the criminal record as referred to in the Act on Checking the Criminal Background of Persons Working with Children (504/2002).

Proof that you do not have respiratory tuberculosis (Section 55 of the Communicable Diseases Act).

- assure la remise en place des tables de manière réactive pour le prochain service, s'assure de la disponibilité permanente des couverts, des produits apéritifs ( bretzels, olives, .) , des tasses à café ( sucre, spéculoos, etc.) , des condiments et du fromage râpé.
-s'assure de la propreté de la vaisselle avant et après le service, du matériel de service (tables, chaises,
ménagères, ..etc) . Selon les besoins de l'organisation du restaurant, assure la remise en état et le
nettoyage de la salle, des toilettes, des vestiaires, de l'office, le vidage des poubelles.

Missions principales :

* Accompagnement éducatif : accueillir, instaurer une relation de confiance, évaluer les besoins, construire et suivre les projets d'accompagnement en lien avec l'équipe pluridisciplinaire, accompagner les actes de la vie quotidienne et proposer des outils adaptés.
  
* Lien avec les familles et partenaires : maintenir une communication régulière, soutenir les démarches administratives, organiser des entretiens individuels et collectifs.
  
* Suivi administratif et qualité : rédiger les écrits professionnels (bilans, transmissions, dossiers MDPH), contribuer à la démarche qualité et à la mise en œuvre des projets institutionnels.
  
* Travail en équipe et réseau : participer aux réunions internes, transmettre les pratiques professionnelles, cartographier et mobiliser les partenaires nécessaires à l'accompagnement.
  
* Veille professionnelle : actualiser ses connaissances et pratiques en fonction des évolutions du secteur médico-social.

* Diplôme d'État d'Éducateur Spécialisé (DEES) exigé
* Connaissance du secteur médico-social et des politiques publiques en matière de handicap
* Maîtrise des spécificités liées au TSA requise
* Maîtrise des spécificités liées au handicap mental et TND appréciée
* Capacités rédactionnelles et bonne maîtrise des outils numériques

title: Technicienne ou technicien peinture industriel, Saint-Pierre-des-Corps (H/F)
description:
En tant que technicienne ou technicien peinture industriel sur matériel ferroviaire TER et RER, vous réaliserez des opérations de préparations du matériel roulant (camouflage, réparation) réalisation de la mise en peinture du matériel.

Vos missions principales sont les suivantes :

* Prendre connaissance des référentiels et des documents de traçabilité nécessaire aux opérations de maintenance.

* Préparations des surfaces : nettoyage, masticage et ponçage avec des machines industrielles.

* Réalisation d'opérations de camouflage  

* Mise en peinture selon différents procédés (peinture hydro au pistolet, pelliculage)

* Respecter les règles établies dans l'entreprise et notamment les règles de sécurité de l'exploitation ferroviaire.  

* Garantir les objectifs qui vous sont fixés dans le respect de ces règles.  

* Respecter les délais impartis dans le cadre du plan de maintenance.

Horaires

* Vous travaillez du lundi au vendredi en soirée : 11H55-19H40

Contexte

* Vous travaillez en équipe au sein d'un établissement de maintenance industriel sur du matériel stationné en atelier ou sur les voies en extérieur.

* Eventuellement en hauteur avec une nacelle élévatrice et dans le train.

* Le port des EPI est obligatoire.

Formation

Dès votre intégration, vous bénéficiez d'un parcours de formation. Afin d'acquérir les compétences et spécificités liées à votre métier, de plusieurs semaines, en binôme. Vous pourrez éventuellement suivre aussi des modules de formation à l'université du Matériel (Techni campus au Mans (72) ainsi que des modules spécifiques pouvant être réalisés dans toute la France. L'ensemble permettra de vous familiariser au fonctionnement et à l'environnement de votre unité de travail.

Profil recherché :
Vous êtes titulaire au minimum du CAP/BEP au BAC dans le domaine de la carrosserie/peinture, avec ou sans expérience, vous possédez de solides connaissances en techniques de peinturage et de pelliculage.

Vos compétences et qualités

* Curieuse, curieux et à l'aise avec les outils numériques

* Vous travaillez dans le respect des règles de sécurité et appréciez le travail en équipe.

* Rigoureuse, rigoureux et maitrise des outils informatiques.

* Maitrisez les différentes techniques de peinture (peinture liquide au pistolet, pelliculage)

Envie de mettre votre savoir-faire au service de projets concrets et de rejoindre une équipe dynamique ? Ce poste est fait pour vous.

Le MOOC Destination maintenance des trains peut vous aider à mieux connaître et comprendre ces métiers : rendez vous ici (https://recrutement-maintenance.sncf-mooc.fr/)

Parce que l'accessibilité commence par l'emploi, SNCF Voyageurs agit concrètement pour l'inclusion des personnes en situation de handicap et met en place des processus de recrutement adaptés à tous.

Envie d'en savoir plus sur nos étapes de recrutement ?

Regardez cette courte vidéo explicative : Les étapes du recrutement Maintenance des trains (https://diva.static.snblymm.com/file_manager/9aafc687-d8a3-47d1-865b-4b91b19d9296_ARV_-_process-de-recrutement-maintenance.mp4)

Rétribution et avantages

Votre rémunération brute annuelle, incluant les éléments variables, sera comprise entre 24 000 EUR et 29 000 EUR. Elle sera déterminée en fonction de votre profil, de votre expérience et des conditions d'exercice de votre poste.

Chez SNCF Voyageurs, nous vous offrons également des avantages spécifiques tels que :

* La quasi-gratuité des trains.

* 28 jours de congés et des RTT.

* Une aide au logement et un accès au parc immobilier locatif SNCF.

* Un accès au restaurant d'entreprise selon votre lieu d'affectation.

* Une indemnité de garde d'enfant de moins de 3 ans à 100 EUR bruts par mois et par enfant.

* Une allocation familiale supplémentaire versée mensuellement en plus des allocations familiales légales pour les agents avec des enfan...

Vous participez à l'analyse des enquêtes de satisfaction et proposez des actions d'amélioration continue dans le cadre de la qualité de service rendu aux clients locataires.

Vous êtes impérativement diplômé(e) d'un BAC +2 en professions immobilières

description:
Fréland (68240)
CDI Temps plein à partir du 01/09/2026

L'accompagnateur de maison ATHOS accompagne au quotidien les blessés dans leur projet de réinsertion sociale et professionnelle, en s'inscrivant dans le cadre d'objectifs personnalisés d'un programme de réhabilitation psychosociale.
La mission de l'accompagnateur s'inscrit dans un travail coordonné avec le personnel de l'équipe socle et de l'équipe pluridisciplinaire.
Il participe à la définition et à la rédaction du projet d'établissement.
Les missions d'un accompagnateur sont notamment de :
- Organiser, planifier, coordonner la venue des blessés devenus membres.
- Apporter écoute et soutien à la personne pour l'aider à progresser sur son chemin de réhabilitation dans les domaines de la confiance en soi, du bien-être, de la remobilisation vers une posture d'utilité sociale et une sociabilisation de l'individu voire si possible de la réinsertion professionnelle.
- Mettre en relation avec les partenaires pluridisciplinaires chaque membre en fonction de ses besoins et des objectifs à atteindre qu'il s'est fixé.
- Pratiquer les évaluations permettant la définition des objectifs pour chaque membre et des moyens à mettre en œuvre.
- Participer à la vie collective et au bon fonctionnement de la maison.
Profil/ Expérience préalable :
- Accompagnement de la personne dans son environnement et favoriser l'intégration sociale,
- Accompagnement de la personne dans la construction d'un projet (de vie) individuel,
- Expérience de l'accompagnement social ou psychosocial,
- Connaissance du monde militaire appréciée,
- pour le personnel militaire ou agent de l'Etat, Expérience approfondie de l'environnement humain au sein des unités, de la prise en charge et du parcours des blessés au sein du ministère des armées,

Créé en 2022, le CFA Eurocom Stratégies, qui repose sur des valeurs fortes d'accompagnement, de diversité et de professionnalisation recherche un/e formateur/trice en Matières Professionnelles (Gestion de la relation clientèle touristique, Élaboration d'une prestation touristique, Gestion de l'information touristique) en classe de BTS TOURISME.
Vous serez basé(e) à Metz (57), sous la responsabilité hiérarchique de la responsable pédagogique.
Notre objectif : ouvrir le champ des possibles pour préparer nos apprentis à la vie professionnelle qui leur ressemble et les épanouit, dans un contexte convivial favorisant la progression pédagogique.
Vos missions principales seront :
- Animer les cours en déterminant en amont les méthodes, moyens et outils pédagogiques adaptés au cours ;
- Elaborer et faire évoluer les programmes pédagogiques et supports de cours ;
- Mettre à disposition des apprenants des ressources pédagogiques.
Vous accomplirez également les missions suivantes :
- Conception des examens blancs ;
- Evaluation des compétences et acquis professionnels tout au long du parcours de formation ;
- Accompagnement des étudiants ayant besoin de soutien pédagogique.
Vos compétences : rigoureux, pédagogue, dynamique et maîtrisant le référentiel.
De formation Bac +2 minimum et justifiant d'une expérience significative en entreprise et/ou dans l'enseignement.
Informations complémentaires
- Poste à pourvoir pour septembre 2026, sur des créneaux de 3h00
- Tarif horaire : 35-45€ selon expérience.

title: Loueur/encadrant Activités en mer PADDLE ET KAYAK (H/F)
description:
Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme dans le domaine de l'encadrement d'activité sportive tel qu'un BPJEPS ou BEES APT (activité physique pour tous) ?

Nous recrutons pour un contrat saisonnier de 2 mois, une personne en capacité d'encadrer légalement des activités de kayak et/ou de stand-up paddle.

Le poste sera principalement basé à Trou d'Eau, La Saline-les-Bains, avec de l'accueil clientèle, de la gestion/location de paddles et kayaks, de la préparation du matériel et, selon les demandes, quelques séances d'initiation ou d'encadrement en paddle et kayak.

Etre titulaire du BNSSA serait un atout pour cet emploi

Vous disposez d'un excellent sens du relationnel, êtes convivial(e), motivé(e), ponctuel(le), et avez l'esprit d'initiative.

Pose à pourvoir immédiatement.

description:

title: Masseur / Masseuse kinésithérapeute (H/F)
description:
L'Oncopole Claudius Regaud recrute un MASSEUR KINESITHERAPEUTE (H-F) en contrat déterminée temps plein dans le cadre d'un remplacement d'un congé parental.  

Le poste est disponible à compter du 05/10/2026.

La finalité du poste consiste à élaborer un diagnostic kinésithérapique et à déterminer des objectifs de soins. Vous devrez mettre en œuvre des actes et techniques de soins de rééducation de façon manuelle ou instrumentale dans un but thérapeutique ou non, pour favoriser le maintien ou l'amélioration de la santé physique, psychique et sociale ainsi que la gestion du handicap.

Vos missions :

- Organiser et coordonner les soins en lien avec les prescriptions médicales.
- Analyser la situation et établir le diagnostic nécessaire à la mise en place d'un projet de soins dans le champ de ses compétences.
- Organiser les activités et la gestion du matériel.
- Promouvoir des actions de santé publique dans son domaine de compétence.
- Participer à la formation des étudiants masseurs-kinésithérapeutes.
- Assurer une veille professionnelle dans son domaine d'activité.
- Développer la recherche dans les domaines en lien avec la kinésithérapie, la rééducation, la réadaptation et la réhabilitation.


*Nous rejoindre c'est
Intégrer un institut au cœur de l'innovation, de l'excellence, de la solidarité et de l'humanisme. *

Profil recherché / compétences requises :

Formations/Diplômes : Diplôme d'Etat masseur-kinésithérapeute obligatoire.
Expérience en milieu hospitalier et maitrise des techniques de kiné respiratoires souhaitées.

Rémunération :

Niveau G1 (2536.67 € brut) selon la grille conventionnelle des CLCC + Prime SEGUR1&2 - Reprise d'ancienneté

Avantages sociaux :

- CSE (chèques vacances, chèques de rentrée, remboursement activités sportives, location vacances...)
- Restaurant d'entreprise
- Crèche d'entreprise

Horaires :
Journée de 7h45 Astreinte le week-end.

title: Aide soignant(e) de jour (H/F)
description:
Le Pôle de Réadaptation est situé à Concarneau et bordé par l'océan, l'Etablissement accueille des adultes et des enfants en soins médicaux et de réadaptation en hospitalisation complète, en hospitalisation à temps partiel et en consultation.

Etablissement dynamique et polyvalent qui compte aujourd'hui 178 lits et 54 places au sein de différentes unités de soin notamment en Addictologie, Locomoteur, Neurologie, Gériatrie, Pédiatrie, Polyvalent, Respiratoire et des activités de Réadaptation par l'Activité Physique Adaptée (RAPA).  Le Pôle de Réadaptation de Cornouaille dispose également de 2 équipes mobiles (adulte et pédiatrique) et intervient dans le cadre d'un partenariat avec l'Hospitalisation à Domicile (HAD) de territoire pour de la rééducation à domicile.

Dans le cadre de l'accueil des patients en hospitalisation complète, L'UGECAM recrute un(e) Aide-soignant(e) de jour, en CDD pour intégrer nos unités de soin.

Vos principales missions seront :
- Aide aux patients sur les séquences de prises en charge sur les plateaux techniques
- Aide au repas des patients pris en charge à la journée
- Accompagnement des patients par les professionnels en balnéothérapie
- Brancardage

Le poste est à pourvoir dès que possible. Travail du lundi au vendredi.

Rémunération brute mensuelle : à de partir 1347.75€ pour un temps partiel 70% + SEGUR 204.52€ (la rémunération peut varier selon le profil et l'expérience) Convention collective UCANSS de niveau 3 EB - Coefficient 257 ; complétée par un 13ème et 14ème mois de rémunération.

-Contrat : CDD à 70 % Rythme : De 8 h 30 à 17 h 30 du lundi au vendredi (horaires lissées sur la semaine)

Le profil recherché:
- Diplôme d'aide-soignant(e) obligatoire.
-Vous disposez d'une bonne communication et relation de confiance. Vous faites preuve de rigueur, réactivité, polyvalence, disponibilité et sens des responsabilités. Vous aimez le travail en équipe.

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Parce que la diversité est une force, l'UGECAM s'engage dans l'inclusion et la non-discrimination pour garantir l'égalité des chances.
Nos avantages :
- Pas d'horaires de coupe (hors protocole d'absentéisme) ;
- 2 repos hebdomadaires consécutifs par semaine et 1 repos compensateur en plus toutes les 2 semaines ;
- Une restauration sur place avec tarif préférentiel, soit de 2,75 euros ;
- Un parcours d'intégration ;
- Horaires stables, établissement à taille humaine ;
- Deux journées de doublure ;
- Services à taille humaine : un management de proximité, un esprit d'équipe et d'entraide entre soignants . ;
- Des outils pour prendre vos fonctions dans de bonnes conditions (fiches de poste, plans de soins, déroulés de mission, trombinoscope .) ;
- Formations pour construire votre parcours évolutif.

Vous recherchez du sens sur vos missions et vous souhaitez vous épanouir au sein d'un Etablissement engagé et porteur de valeurs humaines ? Alors, n'hésitez plus et venez rejoindre nos équipes.

title: Assistant Vie Quotidienne et/ou Vie Sociale (F/H) (H/F)
description:
Le Dispositif d'Accompagnement et de Protection Juridique a pour objectif principal l'exercice des mesures d'accompagnement et de protection judiciaire confiées par le juge des contentieux de la protection ou le juge des enfants.

À cet effet, votre action s'inscrit dans une relation d'aide et de service à la personne afin de favoriser l'autonomie, le maintien à domicile et le bien-être du majeur protégé, à domicile ou en établissement.

Vos interventions sont dirigées prioritairement auprès des personnes isolées, âgées et/ou handicapées, avec une vigilance particulière quant à la prévention de la maltraitance et à la promotion de la bientraitance.

Votre action est large et variée et peut toucher tous les domaines de la vie du majeur protégé, dans le respect de son intimité et de sa vie privée.

MISSIONS :
* Intervention sur toutes les antennes en fonction des besoins identifiés, sous le contrôle du délégué MJPM (Mandataire Judiciaire à la Protection des Majeurs) et avec l'accord des Chefs de service et/ou de la Direction.
* Assister et accompagner le majeur protégé dans l'accomplissement de certains actes de la vie quotidienne et dans la réalisation de petits travaux, dans le but de maintenir son autonomie.
* Réaliser des actions ponctuelles auprès des majeurs protégés (démarches spécifiques, achats, vêtements, pharmacie, documents administratifs tels que la Carte Nationale d'Identité).
* Assurer les liens nécessaires avec les partenaires (achats ponctuels en EHPAD...)
* Accompagner les majeurs protégés lors de rendez-vous médicaux particuliers.
* Accompagner les personnes âgées et/ou isolées (petits dépannages urgents, remise de clés, changement d'ampoules, petites réparations de serrures, veille au respect du plan canicule, etc.).
* Accompagner les personnes dans toutes les démarches spécifiques qu'elles ne peuvent effectuer seules (achat de billets de train, préparation d'un départ en vacances, achats alimentaires, etc.).
* Assurer le suivi et la mise en veille du domicile : nourrir les animaux en cas d'absence prolongée, réceptionner les livraisons de meubles, monter du petit mobilier si nécessaire, etc.
* Assurer le suivi des biens vacants.

Compétences requises :
* Compétences professionnelles : maîtrise des outils bureautiques (Word, Excel, etc.), organisation et rigueur dans la gestion des dossiers, capacité à travailler en équipe et à communiquer efficacement, respect de la confidentialité, des procédures administratives et des textes juridiques en vigueur
* Qualités personnelles : discrétion, adaptabilité et sens des responsabilités et de l'écoute

title: Chargé de relation client secteur automobile (H/F)

Ce BTS forme des experts de la vente et du commerce omnicanal. - Implanter et promouvoir des produits chez des distributeurs.
. Digitalisation et Relation Client à Distance

Organisation et Management Commercial :

- Développer et animer un réseau de partenaires ou de vente directe.
- Contribuer à la stratégie de croissance du chiffre d'affaires

title: Chef / Cheffe d'équipe électricien
description:
Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité, nous recherchons un chef d'équipe électricien H/F.

Le poste :
Vous êtes chef d'équipe ou chef de chantier et avez la responsabilité du travail réalisé par vos équipiers électriciens. Vos missions sont les suivantes :
Réaliser les installations électriques et leurs raccordements,
Réaliser les travaux d'installation et de mise en service des équipements électriques dans les bâtiments tertiaires selon les règles de sécurité,
Câbler et raccorder des installations "courants faibles" (téléphonie, informatique, alarmes),
Effectuer des travaux de dépannage et de maintenance,
Réaliser et poser des chemins de câbles et des produits électriques en apparent ou en encastré,
Positionner une armoire électrique de locaux tertiaires,
Raccorder une armoire électrique aux équipements de locaux tertiaires,
Fixer des éléments de basse tension,
Raccorder des éléments de basse tension,
Câbler un matériel,
Mettre sous tension une installation électrique,
Contrôler une installation électrique,
Respecter les règles de sécurité du travail sous tension.

Profil recherché :
Pour vous épanouir sur ce poste et pour réaliser vos missions dans les meilleures conditions, vous devez être :
Experimenté(e),
Autonome,
Rigoureux(se),
Respectueux(se) des règles.

Vous avez également besoin :
D'une formation technique de type CAP/Bac Pro à Bac +2 en électrotechnique,
D'une expérience de minimum 2 à 5 ans dans l'électricité tertiaire ou un poste similaire,
De connaître et de respecter les normes applicables,
D'une maîtrise des règles de sécurité,
Attestations électriques B2V/BR/BC,
D'avoir un excellent relationnel et un fort sens de la relation client et du commerce,
D'une expertise technique,
De savoir entretenir une relation de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs,
D'apprécier travailler et piloter une équipe.

Si vous vous reconnaissez dans ce profil, cette fonction va vous permettre de vous épanouir !

Exigences particulières (permis, habilitations, etc) : Permis B/Habilitations électriques

Retrouvez cette offre lors du salon Cap vers l'emploi qui se déroulera le 10/09/2026 à Micropolis (Besançon)

title: Agent de fabrication (H/F)
description:
Votre agence Partnaire Orange, avec son équipe dynamique et souriante, a le poste qu'il vous faut ! Nous sommes à votre écoute au quotidien et nous vous assurons des propositions de postes ciblés. Rejoignez-nous et comme nous, soyez fier d'être Partnaire !
