title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

description: Gi Group SpA, Agenzia per il Lavoro (Aut. Min. 26/11/04 Prot. n. 1101-SG) ricerca per azienda multinazionale leader del commercio elettronico: Addetto/Addetta al magazzino Siamo alla ricerca di persone motivate e volenterose per ricoprire posizioni di operatori di magazzino per il nuovo centro logistico di Amazon ad ARDEA (Roma). Il candidato ideale è attento ai dettagli, è affidabile e orientato alla soddisfazione del cliente. Si prevede che i dipendenti comprendano e conoscano tutti i processi e applichino le norme stabilite in materia di sicurezza e prevenzione dei rischi del lavoro, qualità dei prodotti e processi di lavoro standardizzati. Offerta di lavoro Si offre contratto a tempo determinato in somministrazione con possibilità di proroga. Per questa posizione, offriamo una retribuzione lorda mensile fino a un massimo di €1.914,90 sul full time (riproporzionato in base al monte ore specificato da contratto) e altre componenti retributive previste dalla legge, se applicabili. Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è CCNL LOGISTICA, TRASPORTO MERCI E SPEDIZIONE (CNEL I100). La posizione è inquadrata al livello 5 o superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a. Richiesta disponibilità su turni diurni a rotazione, dal lunedì alla domenica con riposi a rotazione. Le opzioni di turno disponibili saranno confermate successivamente nel corso del processo di candidatura. Luogo di lavoro: Via di Valle Caia X, 00040 Ardea (Roma) Principali attività: - Ricevere, controllare, ordinare e riporre tutti i prodotti. - Raccogliere, imballare e spedire tutti gli ordini. Questo sito supporta la consegna di prodotti di grandi dimensioni, dalla TV e grandi elettrodomestici ai divani. - Potrebbe essere necessario trascorrere un po' della vostra giornata di lavoro in altezza. title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: geologo/geologa
description: Grafton ICT* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito AI, Data, Cybersecurity, Cloud, ERP & CRM, Sistemi e Infrastrutture, IMAC e Sviluppo. Per ampliamento nostro network di candidati specializzati, ricerchiamo candidati e candidate interessati/e a valutare opportunità come: RAMS / ILS ENGINEER Le posizioni che potremo proporti potranno includere attività quali: Guidare le attività RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety) lungo il ciclo di vita del prodotto; definire gli obiettivi RAM, allocare i requisiti e pianificare i programmi RAM (previsioni, suddivisione, crescita). Eseguire analisi di affidabilità (MIL-HDBK-217F, parts-count/physics-of-failure), modellazione di disponibilità e costi del ciclo di vita (MTBF/MTTR, Ao) e analisi di manutenibilità (tempi delle attività, dimostrazioni di manutenibilità). Realizzare ingegneria della sicurezza secondo ARP4754A/ARP4761 e MIL-STD-882E: FHA, FTA/ETA, PRA, classificazione dei rischi e monitoraggio delle mitigazioni. Implementare e gestire il processo FRACAS per la raccolta dei difetti di campo/test, analisi delle cause radice, azioni correttive/preventive e crescita dell'affidabilità (es. Crow-AMSAA). Guidare l'Integrated Product Support (IPS/ILS): LSA/LSAR secondo ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F); sviluppare banche dati di supporto logistico (LSDB), elenchi ricambi, attrezzature di supporto (STTE), piani di manutenzione e allineamento della documentazione tecnica (S1000D). Condurre analisi FMEA/FMECA e MTA/RCM; raccomandare modifiche progettuali e miglioramenti alla supportabilità (DfR, DfM, DfS, DfMtn). Gestire la governance dell'obsolescenza: monitoraggio del ciclo di vita, pianificazione Last Time Buy (LTB), ricerca di soluzioni Fit-Form-Function (FFF) alternative, analisi degli impatti d'uso e report di chiusura. Definire i supporti ai test e qualifiche (ambientale/elettrica/EMC) e contribuire alle verifiche di conformità ed accettazione (FAT/SAT). Realizzare dashboard e monitoraggio KPI per le performance RAMS/ILS; pubblicare report periodici e supportare i review di progetto (SRR/PDR/CDR). Mantenere un solido controllo di configurazione in PLM/ERP; garantire la conformità a qualità (ISO 9001/EN 9100), HSE e alle politiche di sicurezza delle informazioni/export-control. Hai queste caratteristiche? Laurea triennale o magistrale in Ingegneria o discipline STEM affini. Competenza nell'uso di strumenti RAMS (es. Windchill Quality Solutions/ReliaSoft), sistemi di requisiti/PLM/ERP (es. DOORS/DOORS Next, Teamcenter, SAP) e analisi dati (Excel/Power BI; SQL). Conoscenza degli standard ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F), MIL-STD-1388 (LSA/LSAR) e dei principali framework di safety engineering (ARP4754A/ARP4761, MIL-STD-882E). Capacità di redigere documentazione tecnica in inglese (report di supportabilità, FMECA/FHA/FTA, piani di manutenzione, estratti LSDB) e di gestire baseline/variazioni di configurazione. Luogo di lavoro: Roma, Genova, Torino, Firenze Entrando nel nostro data-base, potremo contattarti quando saranno disponibili posizioni coerenti con la tua esperienza, le tue competenze e la tua disponibilità. Ti piacerebbe svolgere un percorso di formazione gratuito per poterti muovere con disinvoltura tra gli strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale (AI)? Questa potrebbe essere l'opportunità giusta per te! Gi Group SpA, Agenzia per il Lavoro Filiale di Cittadella organizza un corso di formazione GRATUITO di: Competenze Digitali DI BASE: strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale (IA) Di cosa si tratta? Il corso ha una durata di 40 ore e approfondirà le seguenti tematiche: - Conoscere l'Intelligenza Artificiale (ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, DALL-E). - Usare l'IA per scrivere email, brevi relazioni e riassunti. - Usare l'IA per creare immagini, video e audio. - Fare domande efficaci all'IA (prompt) per ottenere risposte più precise e utili nella vita quotidiana e nel lavoro. - Riconoscere rischi e trappole dell'IA anche da smartphone (notizie e immagini false, rischi per privacy e sicurezza). - Applicare l'IA a situazioni reali e ad attività quotidiane. - Usare l'IA per la ricerca attiva del lavoro da smartphone: ottimizzare CV e lettere di presentazione, simulare colloqui e preparare le risposte, orientarsi tra aziende e ruoli presenti sul territorio. Requisiti: Requisito per la partecipazione al corso è il possesso dell'Assegno Gol rilasciato dal Centro per l'Impiego. Alcune specifiche in più: Il percorso avrà una durata di 40 ore e si svolgerà in Modalità Mista (lezioni online e in presenza) a Cittadella (PD). La frequenza consente, in presenza dei requisiti previsti, il riconoscimento del Bonus Politiche Attive, da richiedere presso il Centro per l'Impiego (CPI) competente del territorio. Il corso è finanziato con fondi del PNRR nell'ambito del Programma GOL ed è rivolto a persone disoccupate domiciliate in Veneto. Al termine del corso di formazione i partecipanti saranno seguiti e supportati da un Consulente Gi Group esperto nel Mercato del Lavoro che li accompagnerà nel reinserimento nel mondo del lavoro. Al Termine del corso verrà rilasciato Attestato di Partecipazione. Se sei interessato/a a partecipare a questo percorso, inviaci la tua candidatura! Facciamo parte di Gi Group Holding (www.gigroupholding.it ) la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, nonché una delle principali realtà a livello mondiale nei servizi dedicati allo sviluppo del mercato del lavoro. Il nostro Gruppo è attivo nei seguenti campi: lavoro temporaneo, Permanent e Professional Staffing, Ricerca e Selezione, Consulenza HR, Formazione, Outsourcing, supporto alla ricollocazione e attività complementari. Siamo presenti in più di 30 Paesi in Europa, Asia e America con un team di oltre 6000 persone. I valori che ci contraddistinguono: attenzione, passione, apprendimento continuo e innovazione, collaborazione, sostenibilità, responsabilità. Consulta tutti i nostri annunci su www.gigroup.it Gi Group S.p.A. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro (Aut. Min. 26/11/2004 PROT. 1101 - SG). L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati ambosessi, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. title: ricercatore universitario/ricercatrice universitaria
description: Il nostro Cliente è un Power Producer nel settore rinnovabili e ci ha incaricato di ricercare la figura di HEAD OF PROJECT DEVELOPMENT & CONSTRUCTION - impianti energia rinnovabili La risorsa, rispondendo al Managing Director Operations, garantirà lo sviluppo, l'ingegneria e la realizzazione degli impianti rinnovabili del Gruppo assicurando la gestione end-to- end del ciclo di vita dei progetti. Si dedicherà in particolare allo scouting e alla valutazione siti, al permitting, all'engineering, al procurement, alla costruzione e al commissioning ai fini di assicurarne la consegna nei tempi previsti nel rispetto dei budget CAPEX approvati, degli standard QHSE. RESPONSABILITA' Governance del processo decisionale e preparazione dei pacchetti autorizzativi per il board Coordinamento dei team di Business Development, Engineering e Project & Construction Engineering e gestione dei rapporti con i fornitori, gli EPC contractor e i consulenti esterni Sviluppo progetti: Supervisione scouting siti, analisi preliminari, studi di fattibilità tecnica, economica e ambientale, Validazione modelli finanziari, business case e analisi redditività, Assicurazione della corretta gestione delle richieste di connessione, budget correlati interfacciandosi con i distributori, Gestione processi autorizzativi completi, Validazione progettazione preliminare e definitiva Engineering Management: Standardizzazione tecnica degli impianti PV/Wind, Approvazione delle soluzioni ingegneristiche e degli studi tecnici prodotti da BD Engineer e consulenti esterni, Selezione e valutazione fornitori tecnici in collaborazione con il Procurement, Assicurazione aggiornamento normative, codici rete e standard progettuali Construction Management: Transizione dei progetti da RTB a NTP fino al PAC, Supervisione della gestione dei contratti EPC, sovraintendo l'avanzamento lavori, validando la progettazione, monitorando i cantieri, gestendo i rischi costruttivi ed effettuando i clean hadover dopo il PAC verso dipartimento amministrativo. Controllo economico e reporting: Elaborazione Capex dei progetti in sviluppo e in costruzione, Approvazione preventiva analisi tecnico economiche di dipartimento, Collaborazione con il dipartimento Finance per la predisposizione di report periodici su budget, liquidità, cash flow, milestone e rischi REQUISITI: Laurea in Ingegneria preferibilmente ad indirizzo elettrico/energetico Approfondita conoscenza del settore rinnovabili Competenze di progettazione preliminare ed esecutiva Competenze di Asset Management Consolidate esperienze di gestione permitting, iter autorizzativi (sottomissione, monitoraggio, integrazioni, relazioni con Enti e Autorità) Gestione dei rapporti con Distributori e TSO/DSO Inglese parlato e scritto per interazione con l'Headquarter e i Clienti. title: Assemblers
description: ADDETTO/A ALL'ASSEMBLAGGIO MECCANICO Per realtà metalmeccanica ricerchiamo una figura da inserire come addetto assemblaggio con scopo inserimento. SCOPO DEL RUOLO Assemblare correttamente le parti meccaniche nel rispetto delle indicazioni ricevute e delle procedure aziendali. Supportare il funzionamento e la manutenzione dei macchinari. RESPONSABILITA' Puntualità e correttezza nell'esecuzione delle procedure di assemblaggio Pulizia e manutenzione dei macchinari Messa in sicurezza delle macchine Ottemperamento degli standard di qualità aziendali Rispetto delle tempistiche previste PRINCIPALI MANSIONI Si occupa dell'assemblaggio meccanico dei componenti di una ginocchiera: posiziona manualmente i velcri adesivi, assembla i passanti, le cuffie e la parte superiore ed inferiore delle ginocchiera tramite una piastrina che viene rivettata, piega le parti in alluminio e confeziona manualmente la ginocchiera. Sulla base delle necessità produttive, utilizza le macchine rivettatrici, le presse, le calandre, le imboccolatrici, prestando attenzione alla corretta messa in sicurezza della macchina e al corretto settaggio prima dell'uso. Verifica la sicurezza e la funzionalità dei macchinari che utilizza quotidianamente. Segue con attenzione le istruzioni per il corretto assemblaggio di ogni parte di ciascuna lavorazione. Effettua la pulizia e la manutenzione delle macchine con l'aria compressa e appositi panni. Effettua il rabbocco dell'olio nei macchinari utilizzati. Gestisce l'inventario utilizzando il conto manuale e la bilancia di precisione contapezzi con cui si contano i componenti presenti in reparto. Si interfaccia con area UT per lo sviluppo di campioni e/o per l'effettuazione di test funzionali. Interagisce con Area CQ per risolvere possibili NC emerse durante il ciclo produttivo. Utilizza quotidianamente attrezzature e strumenti da banco (quali a titolo di esempio trapani, pinze, cacciaviti) per ottimizzare l'assemblaggio meccanico. COMPETENZE TECNICHE Preferibili conoscenze delle procedure di assemblaggio dei componenti meccanici Preferibile conoscenza dei macchinari utilizzati in azienda (presse, calandre, imboccolatrici) Preferibile conoscenza nell'utilizzo di attrezzature manuali (cacciaviti, pinze) Preferibile conoscenza nell'utilizzo di strumenti elettrici (avvitatori, trapani) Orario di lavoro: full-time dal lunedì al venerdì 08.00-12.00/13.00-17.00 Offerta Contrattuale: - Inserimento con contratto di somministrazione a tempo determinato - CCNL applicato: metalmeccanici PMI - Livello di inquadramento: 3° livello - Retribuzione prevista: circa 2000 lordi mensili Luogo di lavoro: Dossobuono di Villafranca (Vr) Via A. description: Grafton ICT* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito AI, Data, Cybersecurity, Cloud, ERP & CRM, Sistemi e Infrastrutture, IMAC e Sviluppo. Per ampliamento nostro network di candidati specializzati, ricerchiamo candidati e candidate interessati/e a valutare opportunità come: RAMS / ILS ENGINEER Le posizioni che potremo proporti potranno includere attività quali: Guidare le attività RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety) lungo il ciclo di vita del prodotto; definire gli obiettivi RAM, allocare i requisiti e pianificare i programmi RAM (previsioni, suddivisione, crescita). Eseguire analisi di affidabilità (MIL-HDBK-217F, parts-count/physics-of-failure), modellazione di disponibilità e costi del ciclo di vita (MTBF/MTTR, Ao) e analisi di manutenibilità (tempi delle attività, dimostrazioni di manutenibilità). Realizzare ingegneria della sicurezza secondo ARP4754A/ARP4761 e MIL-STD-882E: FHA, FTA/ETA, PRA, classificazione dei rischi e monitoraggio delle mitigazioni. Implementare e gestire il processo FRACAS per la raccolta dei difetti di campo/test, analisi delle cause radice, azioni correttive/preventive e crescita dell'affidabilità (es. Crow-AMSAA). Guidare l'Integrated Product Support (IPS/ILS): LSA/LSAR secondo ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F); sviluppare banche dati di supporto logistico (LSDB), elenchi ricambi, attrezzature di supporto (STTE), piani di manutenzione e allineamento della documentazione tecnica (S1000D). Condurre analisi FMEA/FMECA e MTA/RCM; raccomandare modifiche progettuali e miglioramenti alla supportabilità (DfR, DfM, DfS, DfMtn). Gestire la governance dell'obsolescenza: monitoraggio del ciclo di vita, pianificazione Last Time Buy (LTB), ricerca di soluzioni Fit-Form-Function (FFF) alternative, analisi degli impatti d'uso e report di chiusura. Definire i supporti ai test e qualifiche (ambientale/elettrica/EMC) e contribuire alle verifiche di conformità ed accettazione (FAT/SAT). Realizzare dashboard e monitoraggio KPI per le performance RAMS/ILS; pubblicare report periodici e supportare i review di progetto (SRR/PDR/CDR). Mantenere un solido controllo di configurazione in PLM/ERP; garantire la conformità a qualità (ISO 9001/EN 9100), HSE e alle politiche di sicurezza delle informazioni/export-control. Hai queste caratteristiche? Laurea triennale o magistrale in Ingegneria o discipline STEM affini. Competenza nell'uso di strumenti RAMS (es. Windchill Quality Solutions/ReliaSoft), sistemi di requisiti/PLM/ERP (es. DOORS/DOORS Next, Teamcenter, SAP) e analisi dati (Excel/Power BI; SQL). Conoscenza degli standard ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F), MIL-STD-1388 (LSA/LSAR) e dei principali framework di safety engineering (ARP4754A/ARP4761, MIL-STD-882E). Capacità di redigere documentazione tecnica in inglese (report di supportabilità, FMECA/FHA/FTA, piani di manutenzione, estratti LSDB) e di gestire baseline/variazioni di configurazione. Luogo di lavoro: Roma, Genova, Torino, Firenze Entrando nel nostro data-base, potremo contattarti quando saranno disponibili posizioni coerenti con la tua esperienza, le tue competenze e la tua disponibilità. title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: SSAB - Technical Development Manager Italy
description:
Your qualifications
•    Master’s degree in Mechanical engineering, Metallurgy or Mining
•    Fluent Italian and English written and spoken, German is a merit
•    Experience from the steel industry is a merit
•    Analytical skills
We are currently looking for a Technical Development Manager to SSAB Special Steels in Italy.

About the position
SSAB is a highly-specialized global steel company driven by close customer relationships. SSAB Develops high-strength steels and provides services for better perfomance and sustainability. The company is a leading producer on the global market for Advanced High-Strength Steels (AHSS) and Quenched & Tempered Steel (Q&T), strip, plate and tubular products, as well as construction solutions.
As Technical Development Manager, you are playing an important role of supporting SSAB’s customers with your technical competence and support in order to build customer value and profitability. The role also includes close collaboration with Tech support, product development, production and quality. Your geographical business area will be Italy, Greece and Switzerland. You will be traveling approximately 3-4 days a week to meet customers and also to visit SSAB’s mill in Oxelösund, Sweden.

Application
Send your application no later than 24th of September 2018

In this recruitment we collaborate with Hudson.

For more information, please contact
Fredrik Ålund, Researcher, 076-631 94 44

We decline contacts from recruitment agencies and ad sellers regarding this advertisement.
SSAB is a Nordic and US-based steel company. SSAB offers value added products and services developed in close cooperation with its customers to create a stronger, lighter and more sustainable world. SSAB has employees in over 50 countries. SSAB has production facilities in Sweden, Finland and the US. title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

le cas échéant, exécute des métrés contradictoires sur chantier avec les entreprises-       Consulte le Coordinateur de Chantiers pour valider la conformité des matériaux, la qualité des travaux effectués ainsi que la libération du montant réel suivant le plan de financement-       Sur base des métrés effectués, contrôle des factures transmises par les entreprises. Associate Professor or Assistant Professor (promotion track) in Psychiatry

About us

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character. Interdisciplinarity in research and teaching is key to the University's approach to addressing tomorrow's societal challenges. Embedded in Luxembourg's diverse and multicultural society, the University offers a welcoming, multilingual environment where students and researchers from around the world feel at home. Its human size fosters close interaction between students and lecturers, creating a personal atmosphere. With 1,600 members of academic staff for 6,700+ students and 1,000+ Ph.D. candidates, students feel connected and valued on their academic journey. Internationally recognised research drives innovation in digital transformation, health, and sustainable development. This scientific progress is supported by cutting-edge infrastructure and a national commitment to education, research, and innovation. The dynamics of a young university offer rare potential and scope for exploring new ideas.

The Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) is part of the Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine of the University of Luxembourg. DHML coordinates all teaching programmes in medicine, life sciences, nursing, radiography and midwifery. Research at the department integrates basic and translational, molecular and computational approaches with a focus on cancer biology, as well as clinical research projects on human health and disease. Related research within the University encompasses clinical psychology and cognitive sciences at the Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences (FHSE) and research on neurological disorders and dementia at the Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine (LCSB).

The DHML cooperates with national health care centres and with leading international biomedical research institutions. The University of Luxembourg has set a strategic focus on medicine and health and is actively developing its training and research areas in these domains, creating exceptional opportunities in medical, biomedical and mental health initiatives.

Your role

As part of the University's expansion of its medical and health sciences portfolio, the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences seeks to appoint a Professor in Psychiatry. The successful candidate will establish and lead the medical specialisation programme (Diplômes d'Études Spécialisées – DES) in psychiatry, contribute to ongoing initiatives for mental health support and develop a strong line of research in a related field.

The position combines innovative postgraduate teaching in psychiatry with the development of an interdisciplinary research programme, supported by state-of-the-art infrastructure and excellent possibilities for collaborative work, particularly in neurosciences, clinical psychology and cognitive sciences.

The professorship represents a rare opportunity to shape the further development of medical education and research at the University of Luxembourg in close cooperation with colleagues across the University as well as with local and international hospitals.

The successful candidate will:

• Design, develop and implement a modern, state-of-the-art psychiatry curriculum
• Lead the medical specialisation programme in psychiatry and coordinate psychiatry-related teaching activities within the University's study programmes in medicine and other health-related sciences
• Collaborate with faculty colleagues and clinical partners to ensure an integrated and cohesive learning experience for students
• Implement innovative educational approaches and digital learning resources to provide students with comprehensive and engaging learning opportunities
• Establish research activities in psychiatry or related disciplines
• Integrate into ongoing research endeavours in mental health, e.g. Department of Behavioural and Cognitive Sciences, and/or neurosciences, e.g. Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine
• Supervise Master students and PhD candidates
• Contribute to translational efforts in advancing mental health care, e.g. early detection, prevention, innovative treatments, integration of digital solutions
• Engage in clinical psychiatry in Luxembourg

For further information about the role, please contact: Professor Serge Haan, Head of the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences,

Email: Serge.Haan@uni.lu

Your profile

• MD degree and PhD or equivalent doctoral qualification
• Relevant clinical qualification in psychiatry and significant clinical experience; at least 5 years of practice
• Robust experience in teaching psychiatry at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level
• Authorization or eligibility to apply for authorization to practice as a psychiatrist in Luxembourg
• Proven commitment to interdisciplinary and innovative teaching
• Experience in designing and implementing new educational programmes or courses at university level
• Familiarity with modern teaching methods and tools, including online learning platforms and simulation-based training
• Strong track record in clinical and/or biomedical research in a relevant domain, with international recognition, a focus on therapeutic processes and/or aetiological research on mental disorders will be considered an asset
• Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to build and sustain academic and clinical partnerships, particularly with partner universities and healthcare institutions
• Visionary and transformational leadership skills, ability to thrive in a dynamic and pioneering academic environment

Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer

• A strategic opportunity to shape and lead the development of psychiatry education and research within an interdisciplinary environment and a growing medical faculty
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance

How to apply

Applications should contain:

Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & Group MLRO

Purpose of the Job

Quintet Private Bank is a leading private bank in the wealth management sector; we are committed to our clients and their families, and pride ourselves on our personalised service based on a deep understanding of what clients want to achieve. We are a bank headquartered in Luxembourg with branches in Belgium, Denmark, Germany, and the Netherlands, as well as a subsidary in the UK. Supervised by the CSSF we have the ambition to stay true to our purpose to be the most trusted fiduciary of family wealth.

When you join us you are joining a company that values diversity of background, equal access to opportunities, career development, collaboration and inclusiveness. We want our employees to feel proud of being part of a company that is committed to do the right thing. You will have the opportunity to grow your career while developing personally and professionally through various resources and programmes.

The Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & MLRO has primary responsibility for implementation, oversight and monitoring of the Group's financial crime compliance framework (across money laundering & terrorist financing, sanctions, bribery & corruption, external fraud risks), ensuring robust risk management, full regulatory compliance, and effective detection and reporting of financial crime, thereby safeguarding the integrity, reputation, and resilience of the organisation. The role holder acts as the central point of contact with competent authorities and the FIU on financial crime (including specifically AML/CFT ) matters.

Key Accountabilities

Group AML/CFT Framework Leadership:

• Define, implement and maintain a consistent and effective Group-wide FCC framework aligned with applicable regulations and group risk appetite  across all entities.
• Ensure policies, procedures and control expectations are defined, implemented and maintained.    

Group Financial Crime Risk Stewardship:

• Oversee the effectiveness of the financial crime risk control framework .  
• Provide advice,  guidance and challenge to the 1LoD risk and control ownership.  
• Coordinate and maintain the group-wide financial crime risk assessment.

Client Due Diligence Oversight:

• Oversee the effectiveness of client due diligence and client acceptance processes.
• Ensure higher risk clients are subject to enhanced due diligence.
• Monitor compliance with client onboarding and periodic review requirements.            
                        
Suspicious Activity Reporting Oversight:

• Oversee the effectiveness of transaction monitoring and client/transaction screening arrangements including systems/toolings.
• Act as ultimate escalation point for suspicious activity, investigate complex cases and ensure timely and compliant reporting to FIUs.                                    

Regulatory Engagement & Representation:

• Serve as primary contact for regulators, leading inspections, managing regulatory interactions, overseeing regulatory reporting and ensuring remediation of findings for financial crime matters.                                    

Group MLRO Network & Local Oversight:

• Lead and coordinate local MLROs, ensuring consistent governance, escalation, independence and oversight across jurisdictions.
Governance, Board Reporting & Advisory:
• Provide regular FCC reporting to senior management and the Board, advising on risk exposure, control effectiveness and mitigation strategies.
• Ensure escalation of major financial crime risk events, breaches or control issues, ensuring appropriate reporting, documentation and remediation.

Culture, Training & Awareness:

• Promote a strong compliance culture throughout the organisation by designing and delivering effective AML/CFT training and awareness across all levels of the organisation

Knowledge and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Advanced degree or professional certification (e.g., CAMS, CFE) preferred.
• Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in financial crime compliance within the financial services industry (Larger bank / big four preferred), with a focus on AML, ABC, sanctions, and policy framework.
• In-depth knowledge of European and UK regulatory requirements related to financial crime compliance, including AML directives, sanctions regimes, and bribery/corruption laws.                          
• Proven experience in developing and implementing FCC policies, procedures, and controls across multiple jurisdictions.
• Strong leadership and management skills with the ability to effectively oversee a team and drive results in a dynamic and complex environment.

• Collaborative Teamwork                                
• Critical Thinking & Problem Solving                                
• Communication (Verbal & Written)                                
• Conflict Resolution & Negotiation

Technical Skills

The cohesion of liberal societies increasingly depends on high-quality, participatory human services spanning social, educational, and cultural domains. Strategies for reducing barriers to service uptake and enhancement, including through the co-production of specialist knowledge, are essential for the legitimacy of services and underlying policies. The University of Luxembourg aims to play a key role in this public-facing co-productive knowledge landscape. This position will contribute to the development of digital and face-to-face methods for public involvement, by shaping the theories, methodologies, and tools that underpin participatory knowledge production in human services. Active in research, innovation and teaching, the position holder will, in particular:

• Analyse and develop innovative approaches to service user engagement, public outreach, and multi-stakeholder dialogue focusing on unequal power relations and conﬂicting interests. These approaches should combine data-intensive digital tools with face-to-face interventions, enabling exchanges between human service providers and hard-to-reach populations. Examples include collaborative digital platforms, co-creative living labs, interactive exhibitions, and multisensorial participatory interventions

• Design and theorise participatory interventions and public outreach within the context of human services as well as in empirical research methods
• Teach conceptual and methodological courses in the Bachelor en Sciences Sociales et Éducatives (BSSE), playing a key a key role in its ongoing development and expansion. The postholder will also have the opportunity to contribute to the construction of a projected new Master's programme and to teach within the doctoral and lifelong learning programmes of the university

title: Business Analyst (m/f) (réf. E) (H/F)

title: Conseiller professionnel spécialisé - encadrement intensif (m/f) (réf. E) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Au sein du département des Demandeurs de l'ADEM vous conseillez le client dit du parcours intensif, c'est-à-dire le demandeur le plus éloigné du marché du travail, afin d'augmenter son employabilité en lui offrant un service de qualité qui respecte les principes de l'ADEM Missions Assurer un suivi du client; Expliquer le suivi (demande de chômage, élaboration d'un plan d'action et/ou d'un projet professionnel); Élaborer avec le client un plan d'action ayant pour but d'augmenter son employabilité et pour but de définir un projet professionnel en tenant compte de la situation spécifique du client; Analyser la demande d'emploi en fonction de la réalité du marché de l'emploi, du cadre légal et de la situation spécifique du client; Préparer le processus de candidature avec le client (contrôler le CV et la lettre de motivation et toutes les pièces important/antes pour rédiger et compléter les candidatures du client); Proposer des formations aux demandeurs d'emploi afin d'augmenter leur employabilité; Collaborer avec les organismes sociaux externes; Organiser et participer à des ateliers en collaboration avec des institutions externes. Profil Compétences techniques Maitriser les langues du pays (LU, DE, FR) et de bonnes connaissances en anglais sont un atout; Connaître les institutions et les organisations intervenant dans le domaine de l'emploi, de l'orientation et de la formation; Avoir un intérêt pour l'évolution du marché du travail. Compétences comportementales Savoir développer une vue d'ensemble, générer des alternatives et tirer des conclusions nuancées et éclairées; Mettre en œuvre des solutions: prendre l'initiative de résoudre des problèmes et agir pour améliorer les processus; Développer une relation de confiance basée sur sa crédibilité. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut de l'employé de l'État. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission pour devenir employé de l'État. Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un bachelor ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 6 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Expérience Vous avez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans dans le domaine. Langues Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe d'indemnité A2.  Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre de l'Union européenne.

title: Expert en informatique et cybersécurité (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration du cadastre et de la topographie, sous la tutelle du Ministère des Finances, a pour missions principales : La gestion et mise à jour de la documentation cadastrale, incluant le cadastre foncier et le cadastre vertical ; La mensuration officielle ; La gestion et mise à jour de la documentation topographique ; La gestion du système géodésique de référence national ; La gestion du registre national des localités et des rues ; L'infrastructure luxembourgeoise de données géographiques (ILDG) ; La gestion et le développement du Géoportail National du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg, en conformité avec la directive européenne INSPIRE ; L'organisation du stage professionnel, de l'examen et de l'épreuve d'aptitude pour l'obtention du titre de géomètre officiel. Missions Pilotage stratégique et budgétaire: Contribuer à la définition de la feuille de route du service informatique, en alignement avec le plan de développement du CTIE et les enjeux métiers de l'administration; Élaborer et suivre le budget IT : allocation des ressources, priorisation des investissements (matériels, logiciels, services) et optimisation des coûts; Participer à la gouvernance IT : garantir la cohérence des choix technologiques avec les normes et standards étatiques (ex. : RGPD, référentiels ANSSI). Gestion des contrats et marchés publics: Superviser les contrats de maintenance des logiciels métiers : négociation, renouvellement et suivi des SLA avec les éditeurs/prestataires; Piloter des marchés publics pour l'acquisition de matériel informatique (appels d'offres, cahiers des charges, sélection des fournisseurs). Cybersécurité et conformité réglementaire: Cartographier et évaluer les risques cybersécurité spécifiques à l'ACT (Analyse des menaces et vulnérabilités, scénarios d'attaques, etc.); Mettre en œuvre la directive NIS2: Audit des systèmes existants et plan d'actions pour la conformité; Sensibilisation des équipes et coordination avec les parties prenant/antes (DSI, etc.); Gérer les incidents de sécurité : protocoles de réponse, communication de crise et retour d'expérience; Appliquer et faire évoluer les politiques de sécurité (PSSI, procédures internes, bonnes pratiques). Modernisation de l'infrastructure IT: Faire évoluer l'architecture technique: Cloud (govCloud) : migration, optimisation et sécurisation des environnements; Conteneurisation (Kubernetes) : déploiement, orchestration et monitoring des clusters; Infrastructure : serveurs s/virtuels, stockage SAN, sauvegardes et bases de données (Oracle, PostgreSQL et MariaDB). Déployer une solution de monitoring centralisée (supervision des performances, alertes, tableaux de bord); Maintenir la documentation technique à jour (schémas d'architecture, procédures, inventaires). Veille et innovation: Assurer une veille technologique et réglementaire (évolutions NIS2, menaces cybersécurité, tendances DevOps); Proposer des améliorations : automatisation, résilience ou nouvelles solutions alignées avec les besoins métiers. Profil Compétences techniques Compétences métiers: Savoir appliquer la matier/ière, la législation et la réglementation du domaine concerné ainsi que posséder des connaissances en matier/ière de protection des données; Savoir faire une analyse fonctionnelle et technique des systèmes informatiques; Connaître la méthodologie associée à la gestion des opérations informatiques (ITIL) (Information Technology Insfrastructure Library); Connaître les partenaires et intervenants dans les processus liés aux systèmes informatiques; Disposer de connaissances informatiques approfondies (réseaux, administration de systèmes, bases de données, applications web, développement, bonnes pratiques en matier/ière de sécurité, sauvegarde des données, etc.); Vous savez comprendre le fonctionnement des architectures et technologies IT, en apprécier les risques potentiels au niveau technique et assister à la mise en place selon les bonnes pratiques en termes d'hygiène informatique; Disposer de connaissances ou expériences pratiques dans les domaines liés à la l'exploitation de systèmes, réseaux et virtualisation; Connaître les outils Kubernetes, Rancher, Docker; Disposer de connaissances en sécurité informatique; Avoir une bonne compréhension des architectures SAN/NAS; Avoir une expérience en administration de systèmes Linux; Avoir une expérience en scripting (Bash/Python/Powershell) ainsi que disposer des connaissances des outils d'automatisation. Compétences support: Savoir travailler de façon autonome mais également en équipe pluridisciplinaire; Être un bon communicateur; Disposer de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et orales; Être doté de fortes compétences d'analyse et savoir gérer les priorités; Avoir les capacités d'appréhender et capacité d'analyse...

title: Conseiller clients (m/f) (H/F)
description: Conseiller clients (m/f)Acteur majeur du logement abordable au Luxembourg, le Fonds du Logement développe des projets qui contribuent concrètement à améliorer la qualité de vie des citoyens et à répondre aux défis du logement.En rejoignant nos équipes, vous garantissez une expérience client de qualité en répondant à diverses demandes et en apportant des solutions adaptées aux besoins des consommateurs. Vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'image de l'entreprise et dans la fidélisation des clients. Votre rôle au sein de l'équipe :Assurer le suivi des réclamations, dossiers après-vente et sinistres jusqu'à leur résolutionParticiper à la gestion administrative et contractuelle des logements, commerces et parkingsGérer les échanges avec les locataires, propriétaires et partenaires externesAssurer le suivi administratif des dossiers : contrats, avenants, résiliations, indexations et garantiesParticiper à l'amélioration des procédures et de l'organisation du Centre de Relations ClientsGarantir un suivi rigoureux et une bonne qualité de serviceRépondre aux demandes des clients par téléphone, mail, etc.Identifier les besoins des clients et les orienter vers les bons interlocuteursAssurer le suivi des dossiers clients et veiller à leur satisfactionMettre à jour les dossiers clients dans le CRM, NAV et traiter les demandes de manier/ière structurée Votre profil :Titulaire d'une formation de niveau BAC+ 2 en gestion administrative ou commercialeJustifie d'une premier/ière expérience professionnelle de 3 à 5 ans dans le domaine administratif complexe / commercial ou le secteur de l'immobilierVos atouts pour réussir :Excellente maîtrise des outils courants MS Office, la connaissance de CRM et/ou NAV est considérée comme un atoutCapacité à gérer simultanément plusieurs dossiers et interlocuteursMaîtrise des langues usuelles du pays (luxembourgeois, français, allemand, anglais), la connaissance de toute autre langue, dont le portugais, est considérée comme un atoutCapacité d'écoute, sens de l'empathie et de la relation clientsAptitude à gérer les conflits et à résoudre les problèmesCapacité d'analyse, autonomie et gestion des prioritésConfidentialité et discrétionPourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un métier porteur de sens : Au Fonds du Logement, chaque mission a un impact concret : accueillir, loger et accompagner. Nos  collaborateurs contribuent activement au développement du logement abordable au Luxembourg et à l'accompagnement des ménages.Un établissement tourné vers l'avenir, portant desprojets innovants et d'envergure inscrits dans une démarche durable et circulaire.Une culture portée par des valeurs fortes : le respect, la collaboration, l'engagement, l'éthique et la qualité.Un environnement de travail stable et attractif, favorisant le bien-être de nos collaborateurs et l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle.À ce titre, nous vous proposons :Un contrat stable au sein d'un établissement public reconnuUne rémunération attractive tenant compte de votre expérience et de votre niveau de responsabilitéUne allocation de famille, sous réserve d'éligibilitéUne augmentation salariale annuelle garantieUne carte dédynamiquer Pluxee Lunch jours de congés annuelsDes horaires de travail flexibles et la possibilité de télétravaillerDes opportunités de développement professionnel : mobilité interne, budget individuel de formation, cours de langues.Des infrastructures modernes et facilement accessiblesDes évènements internes organisés par notre Fun Team tout au long de l'année (afterwork, teambuilding, visites culturelles et de patrimoine, activités sportives, etc.) Notre processus de recrutement :Nous accordons une attention particulier/ière à la qualité et à la transparence de notre processus de recrutement.Les étapes :1.       Réception de votre candidature avant le  août .       Analyse et présélection des candidatures3.       Entretien avec votre futur manager et un membre des Ressources Humaines4.       Rencontre avec la Direction5.       Validation finale de votre engagement par le Conseil d'administrationEn cas d'entretien d'embauche, un extrait de  vous sera demandé conformément aux exigences liées à la fonction.Signataires de la Charte de la Diversité Lëtzebuerg, nous nous engageons à promouvoir l'inclusion et l'égalité des chances.

title: Coordinateur Business et Opérations (H/F)
description: Description du poste Coordinateur(trice) Business & Opérations - CDI Arhis HR Solutions recrute !
