title: Social, flexibel och glad personlig assistent sökes!
description:
Vilka är Familjen?

Familjen är en trygg och engagerad arbetsgivare med över 17 års erfarenhet av personlig assistans för barn, ungdomar och vuxna med funktionsvariation. Vi arbetar personcentrerat, vilket innebär att varje individ – oavsett om du är assistent, anhörig eller har assistans – ska känna sig sedd, respekterad och bekräftad i vår verksamhet.

Vi heter Familjen av en enkel anledning: vi tror på att personlig assistans fungerar som bäst när den bygger på tillit, trygghet och nära samarbete. För oss handlar assistans inte bara om schema, timmar och administration – utan om människor, relationer och ett vardagsliv som ska fungera.

Namnet Familjen står för att vi vill skapa en verksamhet där både kunder, anhöriga och assistenter känner sig respekterade, inkluderade och omhändertagna. Vi arbetar med ett personligt engagemang och en tydlig målsättning: att bygga stabila arbetsgrupper, långsiktiga relationer och en assistans där individen alltid står i centrum.

Vi samarbetar även med egna arbetsgivare inom personlig assistans och erbjuder effektiva lösningar för lönehantering som förenklar arbetet och skapar mer tid för det som är viktigt.

Vi är verksamma och har assistansgrupper i hela Sverige, från norr till söder, men vårt kontor är beläget i Täby, norr om Stockholm.

En extrakraft

Företagets grundare och ägare har själv arbetat som personlig assistent. Det ger oss en extra förståelse för yrket och vardagen i assistansen – och är en viktig styrka i vårt arbete med att skapa stabila arbetsgrupper och leverera personcentrerad assistans med hög kvalitet.

Om tjänsten

Vi söker nu personliga assistenter till en kvinna som bor på Södermalm i Stockholm.

"Jag lever ett aktivt och socialt liv, tycker om att vara ute bland människor och att hitta på nya saker. Jag har ett stort socialt umgänge som är viktigt för mig, och söker därför assistenter som trivs i en levande vardag. Jag tar mer än gärna promenader och det är viktigt för mig att vi har en personkemi som klickar!

Jag söker dig som är kvinna, har humor, är social och tycker om att skratta. Du behöver vara lyhörd och kunna anpassa dig efter min vardag och mina behov.

Jag har en medfödd CP-skada, vilket innebär att du som assistent fungerar som mina armar, ben och röst. Jag har personlig assistans dygnet runt, fördelat på tre arbetspass."

Vi söker någon som kan jobba dag- och kvällspass med arbetstider kl 09,00-15,15 samt kl 15,00-21,00.

Vi söker i nuläget dig som vill arbeta extra på timanställning eller i en fast tjänst upp till cirka 50 %, med möjlighet att diskutera omfattningen.

Några i assistansgruppen ska vidare på andra äventyr i livet och därför har vi möjlighet nu att erbjuda schemarader till andra gnistrande stjärnor där ute. Kan det vara du?

På grund av arbetsuppgifternas karaktär och behovet av regelbunden och tydlig kommunikation i vardagen är det ett krav att du kan tala, förstå och läsa svenska obehindrat.

Vi värdesätter långsiktighet

För oss är det viktigt att bygga trygga, stabila och långsiktiga arbetsrelationer – både för kundens trygghet och för att du som assistent ska trivas och känna dig säker i din roll. När arbetsgruppen fungerar väl så skapas en lugn vardag med kontinuitet, tydlighet och ett bra samarbete.

Därför ser vi gärna att du som söker ser detta som ett arbete du vill utvecklas i och stanna kvar i under en längre tid. Vi tror på att lära känna varandra, skapa förtroende och bygga en arbetsrelation som håller över tid.

Som medarbetare hos oss får du introduktion, stöd och en närvarande arbetsledning, så att du känner dig trygg i arbetet och har någon att vända dig till vid frågor eller behov av stöd.

Övrig information

Inför rekryteringen har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför vänligen kontakt från mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande aktörer.

Vid frågor om tjänsten hänvisar vi till samma mejladress som används vid ansökan. Glöm inte att använda rätt referens-ID.

title: Application/Integration developer
description:
Dellner Couplers is seeking an Application/Integration developer to join our IT team. Dellner Couplers – a Wabtec Company - is a leading international company delivering sustainable, innovative, and high‑quality products and services to train operators and train builders worldwide. Our product portfolio includes couplers, gangways, and crash management systems for the railway industry.

About the Role

This role offers excellent opportunities for professional growth and development. You will play a key role in supporting the IT organization and participate in development initiatives related to integrations mainly with our ERP system Infor M3 and other systems within Dellner.

We develop and maintain integrations and small applications across Dellner system landscape. Integration based on technologies like M3 IEC, Infor ION, Java, XML, XSL, XSD and programming languages C#, Javascript, .Net, .Net Core, ASP .Net Core, azorpages and REST.



Experience with MS SQL, Visual Studio, Azure Devops and GIT is preferred.



The position involves a varied workload, managing both smaller tasks and larger projects in parallel, and close collaboration with colleagues from multiple functions globally.

Key Responsibilities

    Develop and maintain applications and integrations
    Develop and maintain e-Invoicing and payment files
    Participate in IT projects with integration needs

Organization & Location

The role is based at our head office in Vika, Falun and reports to the Global IT-Manger.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone with a relevant university degree in IT, logistics, analytics, or a related field or equivalent professional experience. Experience in programming or scripting, such as SQL, TypeScript, or VBA, is highly valued. Familiarity with ERP systems is considered an advantage, but not a requirement.

To succeed in the role, you should have:

    Strong analytical skills combined with a holistic mindset
    Strong in spoken and written English
    A structured and organized way of working
    An open-minded and proactive attitude
    A willingness to learn and support others in the team

Who are we

Dellner Couplers is an industry leader in the design, manufacture and service of Train Connection Systems for train builders and rail operators worldwide.

The path we have chosen is characterized by steady growth in a rapidly evolving technological environment. Every day we strive for excellent, innovative and sustainable solutions for our products and services.

Dellner joined Wabtec Corporation in February 2026. This strategic acquisition strengthens our capabilities, enabling us to deliver broader expertise, enhanced innovation and greater value to our customers worldwide.

Here you have a unique opportunity to:

    Join a global and growing organization within the railway industry
    Work with modern ERP and BI solutions in an international environment
    Contribute to the development of data-driven and efficient business processes
    Collaborate with experienced colleagues across multiple functions and countries
    Develop both your technical and business understanding in a role with broad responsibility
    Be part of a company with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and long-term development

At Dellner Couplers, we value collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement. We offer a dynamic workplace where your ideas and contributions make a real impact.

How to apply

Ready to make an impact? Submit your application by 9th of September. Applications can be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Questions?

Contact hiring manager: Björn Thune, +46705517720 or bjorn.thune@dellner.com

title: Sales Development Representative | SCN
description:
Vill du ta nästa steg inom försäljning och komma till ett bolag där du får använda ditt driv, din energi och din förmåga att skapa kontakt – men i en mer långsiktig B2B-affär än ren volymförsäljning?

SCN söker nu en Sales Development Representative till huvudkontoret i Solna. Det här är en roll för dig som trivs i ett högt tempo, gillar att ta första kontakt och motiveras av att skapa nya affärsmöjligheter. Du kanske arbetar med mötesbokning, innesälj eller annan telefonbaserad försäljning idag och känner att du vill vidare till en miljö där erbjudandet är starkt, kunderna är företag och goda utvecklingsmöjligheterna erbjuds?

Om rollen

Hos oss får du en viktig roll i arbetet med att skapa nya affärsmöjligheter. Du ansvarar för den första kontakten med potentiella kunder och hjälper säljarna att fylla pipen med rätt möten, rätt dialoger och rätt bolag.

Det här är inte en roll där du sitter med helt kalla listor dagarna i ända. Du arbetar i en miljö där det redan finns mycket att bygga vidare på – genom SCN:s CRM, tidigare kunddialoger, kampanjer, webinarier och andra aktiviteter. Samtidigt kräver rollen att du själv tar initiativ, driver kontakt och gillar känslan av att vara den som öppnar dörren till nästa affär.

Du blir en del av Customer Success-teamet och arbetar nära säljavdelningen i en organisation där försäljning är en central del av verksamheten. Här finns ett tydligt kommersiellt fokus, korta beslutsvägar och en vardag där många kollegor arbetar nära kunder, affärer och tillväxt.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter

    ta första kontakt med nya och befintliga prospekt via telefon, mejl och andra digitala kanaler
    boka kvalificerade möten åt säljarna och bidra till att bygga en relevant pipeline
    följa upp leads, kundspår och aktiviteter i CRM
    stötta i inbjudningar och uppföljning kopplat till webinarier, kampanjer och andra marknadsaktiviteter
    samarbeta tätt med säljteamet kring prioriterade kunder, segment och mötesmål
    bidra till ett professionellt och engagerat första intryck av SCN i dialogen med kunder och samarbetspartners

Vem vi tror att du är

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av försäljning eller mötesbokning där telefonen varit ett naturligt arbetsverktyg och där du fått träna på att skapa kontakt, väcka intresse och driva dialogen framåt. Du kan ha din bakgrund från försäljning av exempelvis telefonabonnemang, försäkringar eller andra abonnemangslösningar. Annars har du troligtvis jobbat med besöksbokning på ett SaaS-företag eller inom kundservice med inslag av försäljning eller annan prestationsdriven miljö där aktivitet, driv och kommunikation varit centralt.

Det viktigaste för oss är inte exakt vilken bransch du kommer från. Det viktigaste är att du gillar försäljning, tycker om att skapa kontakt med nya människor och vill fortsätta utvecklas i en roll där du får kombinera tempo, struktur och affärsdriv.

Vi tror att du känner igen dig i det här:

    du är trygg i telefonen och gillar att ta första kontakt
    du motiveras av tydliga mål, aktivitet och att se resultat av ditt arbete
    du är social, framåtlutad och har lätt för att skapa förtroende
    du är strukturerad nog att följa upp, dokumentera och hålla ordning i CRM-system
    du trivs i en roll där du själv behöver skapa momentum i vardagen
    du vill utvecklas vidare inom B2B-försäljning och bygga en stark grund i ett bolag med långsiktighet och kvalitet i erbjudandet

Vi ser gärna att du har:

    erfarenhet av telefonbaserad försäljning, mötesbokning eller annan uppsökande kunddialog
    god svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har arbetat mot företagskunder tidigare, men det är inget krav.

Varför SCN?

SCN är ett bra nästa steg för dig som vill lämna en mer transaktionell säljmiljö och i stället komma närmare en långsiktig B2B-affär. Här får du arbeta i ett bolag med stark tillväxt, teknisk höjd och internationell närvaro – men samtidigt i en organisation med korta beslutsvägar och ett entreprenöriellt arbetssätt.

SCN är en del av Addtech-koncernen, vilket ger både stabilitet och goda möjligheter till utveckling över tid. För dig som vill bygga vidare på din säljkarriär i ett sammanhang där affären är mer komplex, kunddialogen mer kvalificerad och bolaget har tydliga tillväxtambitioner, är det här en roll med mycket potential.

Plats: Solna

Omfattning: Heltid

Start: Enligt överenskommelse

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Bygg skalbara datalösningar som driver produktutveckling i en global fordonsmiljö. Här får du äga dataflöden från arkitektur till drift och påverka tekniska beslut.

Här får du arbeta med data som används för att utveckla produkter i stor skala. Rollen passar dig som vill kombinera hands-on utveckling med tekniskt ägarskap och påverka hur moderna dataplattformar byggs och förvaltas.

Om rollen

    Du utvecklar och äger skalbara dataproducter för intern användning.
    Du arbetar nära data, arkitektur och produktion i en tekniskt komplex miljö.
    Du blir en nyckelperson i arbetet med Databricks och PySpark.
    Du bidrar till tekniska beslut, standarder och kontinuerliga förbättringar.

Det här kommer du göra

    Bygga, underhålla och förbättra datapipelines för signal-, diagnos- och feedbackdata.
    Säkerställa kvalitet, tillgänglighet, prestanda och driftsäkerhet i datalösningar.
    Utveckla CI/CD-flöden, testning, övervakning och automatisering.
    Felsöka produktionsproblem och driva rotorsaksanalyser.
    Dokumentera datasets, dataproducter och tekniska lösningar tydligt.

Vi söker dig som har

    Gedigen erfarenhet av Python och modern mjukvaruutveckling.
    Stark praktisk erfarenhet av Databricks och PySpark.
    Vana att bygga och optimera dataplattformar i stor skala.
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta med CI/CD, containerisering och molnbaserade lösningar.
    Förmåga att arbeta självständigt, driva tekniska frågor och stötta andra utvecklare.
    Mycket god engelska i tal och skrift.

Teknik & Verktyg

    Python, SQL och Git/Gerrit
    Databricks och PySpark
    Docker och Airflow
    Azure och Snowflake
    Jenkins, GitHub Actions och Power BI
    Erfarenhet av fordonsdata, tidsserier eller diagnosdata är meriterande

Praktisk information

    Ort: Göteborg
    Arbetssätt: Ej specificerat
    Språk: Engelska

title: Undersköterskor till Hemtjänst – Dagtid måndag - fredag
description:
Undersköterskor till Hemtjänst - Dagtid måndag–fredag

Hemstyrkan söker nu undersköterskor som vill vara en del av ett företag som värdesätter välmående och kvalitet för både anställda och kunder.

Kontor: Söderort Öst (Hammarbyhöjden, Johanneshov)

Arbetstid: 7.00-15.45

Om Hemstyrkan

Hemstyrkan är en av de första hemtjänstutförarna i Stockholm.

Idag bedriver vi hemtjänst i 10 av 11 stadsdelar i Stockholms stad, dygnet runt, och har fyra verksamheter placerade i:

• Västerort (Råcksta,Bromma)

• Söderort Väst (Axelsberg, Hägersten)

• Söderort Öst (Hammarbyhöjden, Johanneshov)

• Innerstaden (Hjorthagen, Östermalm)

Vi har kollektivavtal

Vårt största fokus är att skapa en välmående personalgrupp, med bra schemaläggning, närvarande ledarskap och hög trivsel. Vi tror att när personalen mår bra, då sprider det sig till kunderna och skapar kvalitet i den äldreomsorg vi levererar.

Fördelar med att arbeta hos oss

Hos Hemstyrkan erbjuder vi en arbetsplats där personalens välbefinnande och professionella utveckling står i centrum. Vi arbetar i mindre arbetsgrupper med närvarande och tillgängliga chefer, och vi tillämpar inga delade turer. För dig som söker en stabil arbetssituation finns möjlighet att arbeta måndag till fredag, både dag- och kvällstid.

Vi har en tydlig tilltro till medarbetarens kompetens och förmåga. Eget ansvar och inflytande är viktiga delar av vår verksamhet, och vi arbetar med ett välfungerande kontaktmannaskap där du som undersköterska är fast omsorgskontakt vilket innebär att du ansvarar för “dina” kunder de dagar du arbetar. Varje dag och varje möte ser olika ut, vilket kräver flexibilitet och professionalitet, men ger samtidigt goda möjligheter att själv påverka ditt arbete och skapa god kvalitet för kunden.

Hemstyrkan präglas av ett närvarande och prestigelöst ledarskap. Varje enhet har både arbetsledare och chef på plats, med god kännedom om kunder, anhöriga och verksamhetens behov. Vi arbetar tillsammans med personalen, är delaktiga i vardagen och stöttar vid behov för att säkerställa en trygg och fungerande verksamhet.

Som medarbetare hos oss får du dessutom ta del av friskvårdsbidrag, vilket är en del av vårt långsiktiga fokus på en hållbar arbetsmiljö och friska, trygga medarbetare.

Din roll

Vi söker nu undersköterskor som vill bidra till att våra kunder kan bo kvar i sina hem med trygghet, kontinuitet och värdighet. Arbetet ska präglas av omtanke, kvalitet och ett professionellt förhållningssätt.

I rollen ingår att utföra omsorgs- och serviceinsatser i kundens hem samt att ansvara för kontaktmannaskap, vilket innebär att du skapar kontinuitet och följer upp kundens behov. Du kan även komma att medverka vid vårdplaneringar.

Social dokumentation utgör en central del av arbetet och vi ställer höga krav på noggrannhet, struktur och följsamhet till gällande regelverk.

Vi söker även medarbetare för extraarbete vid behov. Hemstyrkan bedriver verksamhet årets alla dagar.

Som undersköterska hos oss arbetar du med att möjliggöra att våra kunder kan bo kvar i sitt hem med trygghet, värdighet och kvalitet. Ditt arbete ska genomsyras av omtanke, professionalism och närvaro.

Vi söker även personal för extraarbete vid behov. Vi bedriver verksamhet 365 dagar om året.



Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är undersköterska och har en professionell inställning till yrket och till mötet med kunden. För tjänsten krävs:

• Skyddad yrkestitel som undersköterska utfärdad av Socialstyrelsen

• Manuellt B-körkort och körvana, god cykel vana och vilja att använda cykel och gå i tjänsten

• God förmåga att bemöta människor i olika livssituationer på ett professionellt, respektfullt och empatiskt sätt

• Förmåga att arbeta självständigt, ta ansvar och se helheten i uppdraget

• Stabilitet och stresstålighet, med förmåga att hantera varierande arbetsdagar

• Goda kunskaper i svenska, i både tal och skrift

• Grundläggande kunskaper i matlagning och hemmets skötsel



Erfarenhet från hemtjänst eller liknande verksamhet är meriterande men inte ett krav.

Vill du arbeta i ett företag där personalen prioriteras, där ledningen finns nära verksamheten och där du får möjlighet att verkligen bidra till livskvalitet för dem vi hjälper, då kan Hemstyrkan vara rätt arbetsplats för dig.

title: Avdelningschef för ekonomi och verksamhetsstöd till Sametinget
description:
Avdelningschef för ekonomi och verksamhetsstöd till Sametinget

Vill du leda och utveckla viktiga stödprocesser i en myndighet med ett unikt samhällsuppdrag? Sametinget söker en trygg, analytisk och strategisk ledare med stark ekonomisk kompetens.

Placering: Giron/Kiruna, Staare/Östersund eller Jåhkåmåhkke/Jokkmokk, med möjlighet till distansarbetsavtal.

Rapporterar till: Kanslichefen.

Ansvar: Budget-, personal- och verksamhetsansvar för en avdelning med omkring 15 medarbetare.

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.

Om Sametinget

Sametinget är ett folkvalt samiskt parlament och en statlig myndighet från 1993. Uppdraget är att främja och utveckla en levande samisk kultur, medverka i samhällsplaneringen och bevaka att samiska behov beaktas. Myndigheten finns i Kiruna, Östersund, Jokkmokk och Tärnaby och har omkring 70 anställda.

Om rollen

Som avdelningschef för ekonomi och verksamhetsstöd får du en central roll i Sametingets ledning och utveckling. Du ansvarar för myndighetens ekonomiska förvaltning, interna service, IT/IS samt verksamhetsutveckling inom området. Du arbetar nära kanslichefen, styrelsen och nämnderna och bidrar till stabilitet, kvalitet och framdrift i myndighetens stödprocesser.

Avdelningen omfattar ekonomi, HR, kommunikation, juridik, administration, intern service och IT/IS. Rollen innebär budget- och personalansvar för omkring 15 medarbetare.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

• leda, utveckla och följa upp avdelningens arbete inom ekonomi, administration, intern service och IT/IS

• ansvara för budgetarbete, budgetuppföljning, bokslut och årsredovisning

• säkerställa god kvalitet i ekonomisk förvaltning, redovisning och interna stödprocesser

• ansvara för och bidra i upphandlingar samt andra utvecklingsfrågor inom avdelningens ansvarsområde

• ge strategiskt och operativt stöd till kanslichef, styrelse och nämnder

• skapa goda förutsättningar för medarbetare genom tydligt ledarskap, struktur och utvecklingsfokus

Krav för rollen

För att vara aktuell för tjänsten behöver du uppfylla följande krav:

• akademisk examen inom ekonomi

• stor erfarenhet av budget- och bokslutsarbete

• erfarenhet av budgetuppföljning, årsredovisning och redovisningsfrågor

• tidigare chefserfarenhet

• erfarenhet från offentlig förvaltning

• god förmåga att leda, utveckla och inspirera medarbetare

• mycket god kommunikativ förmåga samt ett analytiskt och strategiskt förhållningssätt

Meriterande

Det är meriterande om du även har:

• erfarenhet från politiskt styrd organisation

• kunskaper i samiska språk

• kunskap om samisk kultur och samiskt samhällsliv

• erfarenhet av upphandlingar

• kunskap om förvaltningsjuridik

• förståelse för IT/IS-utveckling på strategisk nivå

Personliga egenskaper

Vi söker dig som är trygg i ditt ledarskap och har förmåga att skapa riktning, tydlighet och engagemang. Du är stresstålig, analytisk och utvecklingsorienterad, med ett strategiskt förhållningssätt och förmåga att omsätta mål och uppdrag till konkret handling.

Du kommunicerar tydligt, bygger förtroende och har lätt för att samarbeta med olika funktioner och beslutsnivåer. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Ansökan

Ansök med bifogat CV i PDF form via https://www.adecco.com/sv-se/lediga-jobb?jobLocation=Kiruna,+Sweden&lat=67.8482231&lng=20.2975445&radius=20 sista ansökningsdag 31/8 2026. Vi håller löpande intervjuer.

För ytterligare information om tjänsten eller rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta senior rekryteringskonsult Stefan Wangdell på Adecco, 076-138 48 17 eller stefan.wangdell@adecco.se.

Fackliga kontaktpersoner nås via växeln, 0980-780 30.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Lead Architectural Project Manager - Data Centres
description:
Data centres play a vital role in society, and the decisions made today will shape the digital and sustainable infrastructure of tomorrow. At Arkitema, we are intensifying our focus on data centres and strengthening our capabilities to support clients in delivering the next generation of digital infrastructure.



Therefore, we are looking for a Lead Architectural Project Manager to join us. In this role, you will work closely with clients, colleagues, and partners to shape and deliver data centre projects from early concept through to design and implementation. From day one, you will engage directly with clients - leading meetings, guiding decision-making, and driving the delivery of CSA disciplines across projects. You will translate global concepts into locally compliant solutions while structuring teams and workflows to ensure efficient execution.

Arkitema was established in 1969 making us one of Denmark's oldest architectural firms. Today, we are well positioned in Scandinavia with offices in Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

In our markets we provide wide range of competencies in our areas of expertise. We cover sectors and disciplines like healthcare, industry, transformation, landscape and residential construction.

Since 2019 Arkitema has been part of COWI, one of Scandinavia’s leading engineering and consultancy companies. Together with customers, partners and colleagues, we shape a future where people and societies grow and flourish. We do that by co-creating more sustainable and beautiful solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and many generations ahead.



Lead multidisciplinary design for mission‑critical projects

As Lead Architectural Project Manager you will provide overall design leadership. You will align client requirements, technical disciplines and operational priorities, and help teams navigate complexity without losing sight of what creates value - throughout all project phases from concept to handover.



Your key responsibilities will be to:

    Lead multidisciplinary design delivery for data centre projects.
    Ensure coordinated delivery across a large multidisciplinary project team, including discipline leads and international engineering teams.
    Set clear direction, create clarity, and facilitate effective collaboration.
    Oversee project financials, reporting to steering committees, and proactive risk management.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you -colleagues, partners and customers. You act respectfully, listen actively and follow through on your commitments. And you remain curious about new perspectives and ways to improve.

On top of that, you will have:

    A relevant educational background in project management, architecture, engineering or a related field.
    Experience working with engineering consultancy, technical advisory or complex infrastructure projects.
    Experience from data centre projects or other large‑scale, mission‑critical facilities.
    Experience leading large, multidisciplinary project teams.
    Professional proficiency in English – verbal and written.

Work location

The role can be based in any of our offices across Scandinavia:

Norway – Oslo, Trondheim or Stavanger.

Sweden – Stockholm or Gothenburg.

Denmark – Copenhagen or Aarhus.



We work in international and multidisciplinary teams, and many of our projects are delivered across offices and borders.



Do you have more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Talent Acquisition Specialist, Mette Gutte on mtgt@COWI.com



Get to know us even better at our website, www.arkitema.com and www.cowi.com



A place to work and so much more

At Arkitema, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.



Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you are interested in joining Arkitema. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so the role may close as soon as we find the right match.



Diversity is fundamental to Arkitema, inclusion is key

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

title: Workforce Management Expert
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description:
Job Description

WHAT YOU WILL DO

As a Workforce Management Expert, you translate labour standards and labour demand into practical, store-ready workforce plans. Rather than managing day-to-day staffing, you design and evolve the workforce planning logic that determines how stores are staffed across markets and formats.

You will help define how customer demand, traffic patterns, operational workload and labour standards are translated into workforce requirements, ensuring staffing is realistic, compliant, fair and scalable.

You will:

    Own and maintain the global WFM scheduling rulebook, defining how staffing and scheduling should be built
    Ensure scheduling rules are aligned with global standards, local labour regulations and operational needs
    Define standard rosters by store format and segment, including role mix and coverage by daypart
    Translate customer demand, operational workload and labour hours into recommended staffing levels by role, skill and time of day
    Create and maintain shift templates aligned with customer traffic patterns, demand peaks and operational rhythms across front of house, back of house and omnichannel operations
    Define and evolve skill logic to reflect operational changes, productivity improvements and new store initiatives
    Develop workforce planning logic that reflects store operations, customer flow and workload drivers across retail formats
    Partner with Sales Markets to integrate local labour laws into global workforce planning standards
    Collaborate closely with Labour Standards and Labour Demand Experts to ensure labour standards, workload assumptions and demand drivers are accurately reflected in staffing logic
    Work with Tech and WFM product teams to translate planning rules into system configuration and algorithm inputs
    Provide expert guidance and support to markets on workforce planning, staffing logic and scheduling principles
    Support root-cause analysis and continuous improvement related to workforce productivity, staffing effectiveness and scheduling performance

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH

You will work closely with Sales Markets, Labour Standards and Labour Demand teams, Tech and WFM product teams, as well as global Retail Operations and Controlling stakeholders. In this role, you act as a subject-matter expert and trusted partner, helping connect labour standards, workload drivers and operational realities with practical workforce planning solutions.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a structured and analytical expert who understands both the logic behind workforce planning and the realities of physical retail operations. You enjoy translating complex operational challenges into practical and scalable workforce planning solutions.

We are looking for people with:

    Deep experience within workforce planning, workforce design, scheduling optimisation or WFM systems
    Strong understanding of retail, logistics, field operations or other customer-facing operational environments where staffing is driven by workload, customer demand and operational activities
    Experience translating demand drivers, workload assumptions or productivity standards into staffing requirements and scheduling rules
    Strong understanding of operational planning, workforce deployment and labour productivity
    Solid knowledge of labour regulations and scheduling compliance requirements
    Experience translating analytical models, operational rules or workforce logic into practical guidance and scalable ways of working
    Strong documentation skills and high attention to detail
    Confidence working cross-functionally and influencing without formal authority
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

An example of our benefits:

    25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
    H&M Incentive Programme – HIP. Learn more about the programme here.

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

title: Off-cycle M&A Intern- Stockholm

title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Join us to deliver a smoke- free future Senior Digital Marketing Manager Sweden!

We’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and have been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.

We are approximately 450 employees based in Stockholm, working in various functions and teams and together we are collaborating to deliver a smoke-free Sweden.

Role summary:

In this role you will lead the strategy, activation, and optimization of our digital marketing ecosystem across CRM, Paid Media, Retail Media, and Social Media.

In this pivotal leadership role, you will drive consumer acquisition, engagement, retention, and loyalty through data-driven marketing programs and omnichannel experiences. You will be responsible for shaping how our brands connect with consumers across the full customer journey, maximizing marketing effectiveness while delivering measurable business outcomes.

Working cross-functionally with Brand, Commercial, Consumer Experience, E-commerce, and Digital teams, you will transform insights into action, champion innovation, and continuously evolve our marketing capabilities through automation, personalization, analytics, and emerging technologies.

If you're passionate about growing brands, accelerating consumer engagement, and delivering market-leading results through digital marketing excellence, this is your opportunity to drive meaningful business impact while shaping the future of our brands in Sweden!



Main accountabilities:

    Shape and execute the digital marketing strategy across CRM, Paid Media, Retail Media, and Social Media.
    Drive consumer acquisition, engagement, retention, and loyalty through best-in-class digital experiences.
    Lead marketing investments and performance optimization to maximize business impact and return on investment.
    Develop personalized consumer journeys using data, automation, and CRM innovation.
    Build engaging social media and content strategies that strengthen brand relevance and advocacy.
    Leverage insights, experimentation, and analytics to fuel continuous growth.
    Lead cross-functional collaboration and champion digital marketing excellence across the organization.
    Coach and develop a high-performing team while driving innovation and continuous improvement.                                                                                                                                                                                                    

Qualifications & Skills:

    Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Digital Marketing, Economics, or a related field.
    7+ years of experience in digital marketing, CRM, performance marketing, media management, or related fields.
    Proven track record of leading integrated CRM, Paid Media and Social Media strategies.
    Strong understanding of consumer lifecycle marketing, audience segmentation, personalization, and automation.
    Experience with digital analytics, attribution, performance measurement, and marketing investment optimization.
    Knowledge of marketing technologies, AI-enabled marketing solutions, and digital innovation practices.
    Strong leadership and people development capabilities with experience coaching and building high-performing teams.
    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
    Proficient in English, Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.                                                                                    



What we offer:

Our success depends on the dedicated people who come to work every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join us at Swedish Match and you too can:

• Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.

• Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.

• Enjoy flexibility of hybrid way of working - split your time between working from our office or the comfort of your home, where it works best for you in line with business needs.

• Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provides endless opportunities to progress.

• Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to deliver a smoke-free future.

title: Mechanical Lead - Data centres
description:
Data centres play a vital role in society, and the decisions made today will shape the digital and sustainable infrastructure of tomorrow. At COWI, we are intensifying our focus on data centres and strengthening our capabilities to support clients in delivering the next generation of digital infrastructure.

We are therefore looking for a Mechanical Lead to join us on this journey, becoming an integral part of our growing organisation and helping evolve our data centre environment through your expertise in complex projects.

Be part of building COWI’s data centre environment.

Data centres are a strategic growth area at COWI. As we scale our presence in this market, we are enhancing our multidisciplinary capabilities and working closely with clients to develop reliable, efficient and sustainable data centre solutions. In this role, you will engage closely with clients, colleagues and partners to develop and deliver data centre projects from early concept through design and implementation.

As Mechanical Lead, you will bring your expertise in mechanical systems into multidisciplinary teams, helping translate customer needs into robust and future-ready solutions. You will be part of a professional environment experiencing rapid growth and strong strategic focus within COWI, with opportunities to deepen your expertise, grow alongside the organisation, and play an active role in shaping our approach to data centre projects and customer collaboration.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

    Contribute to the design and delivery of data centre projects, ensuring high technical quality within your discipline.
    Engage in dialogue with customers to understand their needs and translate them into effective technical solutions.
    Lead and contribute to data centre projects, ensuring coordination across multidisciplinary teams.
    Support project development from early concept stages through design, tender and construction.
    Collaborate with colleagues across engineering, architecture, sustainability and environmental advisory.

Examples of discipline-specific responsibilities may include:

    Lead mechanical design and advisory for data centre facilities.
    Act as mechanical lead within projects, ensuring technical quality and coordination.
    Contribute to detailed technical dialogue with clients and project stakeholders.
    Support project development from concept to detailed design.
    Contribute to innovative and sustainable data centre solutions.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you will have:

    A relevant educational background in engineering.
    Experience working with design of data centres, engineering consultancy, technical advisory or complex infrastructure projects.
    Experience from data centre projects or other large-scale mission critical projects.
    Professional proficiency in English.

Additional role-specific qualifications may include:

    Experience with mechanical systems for data centres.
    Experience working with large-scale infrastructure or industrial facilities.
    Experience leading technical teams or complex engineering projects.

Work location

The role can be based in any of our offices across Scandinavia. This includes offices in:

Norway – Bergen, Trondheim, Stavanger, Oslo and Fredrikstad

Sweden – Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö

Denmark – Copenhagen, Kongens Lyngby, Vejle, Aarhus, Odense and Aalborg

We work in international and multidisciplinary teams, and many of our projects are delivered across offices and borders.

Do you have more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com. Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com and www.arkitema.com where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so the role may close as soon as we find the right match.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

title: Installation Lead
description:
Bring the Future of Wind Propulsion Onboard

About Us

Wind helped us discover our planet, and now it can help us preserve it. Our vision is to provide wings for a shipping revolution, and we have two strong mother companies to back us up: Alfa Laval and Wallenius.

Would you like to contribute to this change, then join our fast-growing, highly competent and passionate team. AlfaWall Oceanbird AB is a 50/50 joint venture, owned by Alfa Laval and Wallenius but operated as an independent company. We are developing wing sail technology for the global shipping market and are now looking for an Installation Lead to join our team. Help us bring wind propulsion from shore to ship!

The role

As Oceanbird moves from a prototype stage into commercial customer delivery, successful installation is becoming one of our most important capabilities.

As Installation Lead, you will turn plans and technical solutions into safe, efficient and wellcoordinated installations at shipyards and onboard vessels. You will also be responsible for our demonstrator wing in Landskrona, coordinating its operation, maintenance and test readiness so that it provides the data needed for our continued development.

You will be part of the Project Management Office and work closely with our project managers. During installations, you will lead a cross-functional team of approximately 3–8 people, including electricians, service engineers, technical specialists and external contractors.

The Project Manager retains overall responsibility for the customer project, while you lead the dayto-day installation activities and safe execution at the shipyard, in harbor or at sea.

Your main responsibilities:

• Plan, prepare and lead installation and commissioning activities at shipyards/harbour and onboard vessels.

• Translate project and engineering requirements into practical installation plans, work sequences, resource needs and schedules.

• Coordinate the on-site installation team and act as Oceanbird’s operational interface with shipyards, vessel crews, customers and subcontractors.

• Lead the safe execution of installation work, ensuring that risk assessments, work permits, toolbox talks and agreed safety procedures are in place and followed.

• Monitor progress, quality and safety, resolve practical issues and escalate risks or decisions when required.

• Develop and maintain installation procedures, method statements, SOPs, checklists and installation manuals.

• Capture lessons learned and use them to improve future installations, documentation and ways of working.

• Coordinate the operation, maintenance, inspection and test readiness of the demonstrator wing and its supporting equipment in Landskrona.

• Plan activities together with the Landskrona team and work closely with our teams in Flemingsberg to incorporate experience from installations and testing into our continued development.

Who are you?

You are a practical and confident installation leader who can bring people from different disciplines together, create structure and maintain focus on safety and delivery—even when conditions change.

You are likely to have:

• Experience leading installations, commissioning, service or major maintenance involving complex mechanical or electromechanical equipment.

Classified by Alfa Laval as: Business

• Experience from commercial vessels and shipyards, ideally involving bulk carriers, tankers or similar vessel types.

• Experience from newbuild projects and working closely with shipyards in Asia is highly valuable.

• A relevant engineering qualification within mechanical, marine, electrical or a related technical field. This could be a vocational, college or bachelor-level qualification, or equivalent experience.

• A strong understanding of safe working practices in shipyard, industrial or onboard environments.

• Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams, contractors and external stakeholders.

• The ability to produce clear and practical technical documentation, including SOPs and installation manuals.

• Professional proficiency in English and the willingness to travel internationally and work onboard vessels.

You are safety-conscious, structured and calm under pressure. You communicate clearly across technical disciplines and cultures and are comfortable moving between planning, documentation and hands-on execution.

Location and travel

We are open to discussing the location for the right candidate, although proximity to either Flemingsberg or Landskrona is preferred.

Regular international travel and periods of work at shipyards and onboard vessels are an integral part of the role.

What we offer

At Oceanbird, you will help turn a bold vision into working technology at sea. You will see the direct result of your work as our wing sail technology moves from development and testing to installation onboard commercial vessels—and ultimately into operation at sea.

This is an opportunity to shape not only how our first commercial installations are delivered, but how Oceanbird will install wing sails around the world in the future. Working alongside highly skilled and passionate colleagues, you will influence our installation methods, safety standards and ways of working—and contribute directly to making wind a powerful part of cleaner shipping.

Join us in redefining the future of clean shipping.

Apply today and be part of a journey that truly makes a difference!

We review applications continually so please send in your application as soon as possible.

We don't accept applications sent directly via email.

On Thaimassage in Borås is looking for a full-time Thai masseuse for our salon in Viared, with start 2026-10-01. Accommodation can be arranged for 4500SEK/month.

We are a certified company, which means that you need to have a minimum of 150 hours of training.

If you do not speak Swedish, you need to learn it = we can adapt the service so that you can study Swedish at the same time (SFI) = then you work about 65% of the time while you study.

can also do foot care, that is a plus.

If you need accommodation, you can rent a room.

After a three-month probationary period, we can offer you a permanent position.

title: Housekeeping Associate - Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
description:
Step into a role that redefines excellence at the Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, a hallmark of hospitality since 1971 in the heart of Sweden's bustling capital. Aligned with our innovative owners Archer Hotel Management and Marriott International, we merge rich cultural history with modern luxury and a deep dedication to sustainability.

We are now looking for detail-oriented and motivated Housekeeping Associates to join our team! If you take pride in creating a clean, welcoming environment and enjoy working in a fast-paced setting, we’d love to hear from you.

If you have a passion for hospitality and a focus on delivering outstanding guest experiences, we want to hear from you!
We believe in nurturing talent and providing opportunities for professional development and offer a workplace where you can learn, grow, and thrive.

·      Clean and maintain guest rooms, public areas, and workspaces

·      Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction, assuring personalized service and addressing guest concerns or needs promptly

title: Senior Dynamics 365 CRM Developer
description:

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will help shape and modernize Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service solutions in a complex public sector environment where stability, long-term quality, and real business value matter. The work spans the full development lifecycle and combines hands-on development with solution design, architecture input, and close collaboration with stakeholders. You will work in an environment that still relies on strong on-premises capabilities while also preparing for future cloud migration initiatives using Power Platform and Dynamics 365 Online. It is an exciting role for you who want to solve technically demanding challenges, work close to the business, and contribute to solutions that support important services for citizens.

    You will support upcoming cloud migration initiatives through development in Power Platform and Dynamics 365 Online.

Requirements

    At least 5+ years of Dynamics 365 CE Online development
    Extensive experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Dynamics CRM development in on-premises environments
    Experience in Dynamics CE on-premises implementation
    Experience in plugin development and workflow development
    Experience in integration and system development in on-premises server environments
    Good knowledge of C# and .NET
    Good knowledge of JavaScript
    Good experience in webservices
    Good experience in SQL Server
    Experience with Power Apps and Power Flow
    Good experience in WCF/SOAP
    Good experience in REST API/web API
    Experience with Dynamics 365 CE in sales, marketing, and service
    Fluency in Swedish and English, written and spoken

Nice to have

    Experience working with municipal or government organizations
    Experience leading or coordinating development teams

What We Offer

Application

title: Senior Business Controller – Software & Tech
description:
Would you like to combine business controlling, financial analysis, and business-oriented advisory in an environment where software and advanced technology are at the core? 📊💻

We are looking for a Senior Business Controller for a long-term consulting assignment in Gothenburg. In this role, you will work closely with senior decision-makers, transforming financial data into insights, challenging assumptions, and contributing to well-informed business decisions.

You will work in a technology-intensive organization developing software for modern vehicles, including digital services, infotainment, and advanced driver assistance systems. 🚗

About the Role

As a Senior Business Controller, you will have broad responsibilities combining operational controlling, project and program follow-up, and business partnering. You will work closely with senior management and act as a proactive financial partner in both strategic and operational matters.

An important part of the role is creating transparency around costs, budgets, and forecasts. You will analyze financial performance, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure that relevant decision-making data and insights are available.

Your main responsibilities will include:

    

Acting as a financial partner to senior management, providing clear analyses and recommendations.

    

Driving monthly financial follow-up, including variance analyses and performance reviews.

    

Working with OPEX, cost control, and monitoring financial KPIs.

    

Managing budgets, forecasts, and long-term financial planning for various programs and projects.

    

Monitoring project costs, burn rates, and forecast accuracy, and highlighting deviations.

    

Collaborating cross-functionally with engineering, procurement, program management, and other functions.

    

Reviewing purchase requests and supplier invoices to ensure compliance with budgets, contracts, and internal guidelines.

    

Driving recurring budgeting and forecasting processes.

    

Preparing financial analyses and presentations for senior management.

    

Proactively identifying financial risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement. 📈

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone with a solid foundation in controlling who thrives in a business-oriented role. You are analytical and structured, but above all, you have the ability to understand the business behind the numbers and translate your analysis into concrete recommendations.

You are comfortable working independently, challenging existing assumptions, and communicating financial matters to both financial and non-financial stakeholders.

Ideally, you have:

    

A university degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or equivalent.

    

At least 3–5 years of experience in business controlling, financial controlling, business partnering, program controlling, or a similar role.

    

Solid experience in budgeting, forecasting, and financial modelling.

    

Strong analytical skills and experience working with large volumes of financial data.

    

Experience working cross-functionally and closely with senior stakeholders.

    

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

    

Excellent spoken and written English.

Experience from automotive, technology, engineering, or another development-intensive environment is considered an advantage. Previous experience in project controlling, program controlling, or automotive development programs is also a plus.

Additional Merits

Experience with the following is considered an advantage:

    

Power Query / Excel Query and macros

    

Power BI

    

SAP S/4HANA

About the Assignment

📍 Location: Gothenburg, on-site 📅 Start date: September 1, 2026 ⏳ Assignment period: Until August 31, 2027 🕒 Scope: Full-time, 40 hours per week

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to take on a central financial role close to the business while working in an environment where finance meets software development and advanced technology.

Does this sound like the right next assignment for you? Submit your application today. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. 🚀

title: Product Merchandising Lead
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz Sverige AB
description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

    Act as Contact point and partner-up with Sales Market Commercial teams on stock and inventory topics to facilitate strong commercial execution in Sales Markets  

    Drive transparency/ consistency and secure sharing of best practices across Sales Markets on product merchandising/ commercial execution  

    Challenge Sales Markets' bottom-up demand plans from a stock-level perspective (only if needed or upon request)

    Support Sales Markets in setting and adjusting price maps to reflect local competition and stock positions  

    Responsible for the forecasting of supply in relation to demand, sharing insights and corrective measures  

    Decide and provide Sales Markets articles for final sale/ clearance, as well as for special campaigns per channel

     Decide and provide markdowns (pricing) in collaboration with Inventory Optimization Leads (who provide analyses) and other inventory management measures to Sales Markets (e.g., markdowns if sell-through deviates from other markets)  

    Follow up and forecast R&D for Sales Markets  

    Capture learnings from exit and liquidation cycles to inform future pre-season planning/ buying quantifications

    Act as the key point of contact for assigned SMs and warehouses on all allocation, replenishment, and stock management topics  

    Follow up stock on Sales Market level and review stock-balancing scenarios within a Planning Market (based on analyses provided by Inventory Leads) Responsible for the initial allocation from warehouses to stores in line with Sales Market plans (in target state, via AB2.0)  

    Responsible for adjustments to replenishment speed and setting replenishment blocks or stops for seasonal stock/ predictable demand  

    Set backstock list for articles that needs to be removed from the shopfloor/ pick locations  

    Create transparency on incoming deliveries/ stock status to SM Commercial teams and Store Managers through regular stock update reports



WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with...

    2–4 years in product merchandising, retail planning, or commercial operations within retail, fashion, or FMCG  

    Bachelor's or Master's degree or similar in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative field

    Commercial expertise: Solid understanding of retail and product merchandising processes  

    Analytical capabilities: Able to interpret sell-through and stock reports to identify areas of improvement

    Communication skills: Clear communication and collaboration skills across Markets and Continent teams  

    Tool proficiency: Good command of Excel and interest in BI tools (e.g.; Power BI)  

    Attention to detail: Detail-oriented; ensures high data accuracy in article tracking and reporting

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount include H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.



JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it's our people who make us who we are.

If you feel your experience, skills and ambitions are right for this role, apply by sending your application in ENGLISH through the career site as soon as possible but no later than 2nd August, 2026.

This is a permanent position. The position is based in our Office in Stockholm and reports to Planning Market Manager.  

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

title: Project Planner
description:
Winthrop Technologies is Europe's only dedicated data centre delivery partner, offering full turnkey solutions from design through to construction and commissioning. Headquartered in Dublin, we deliver projects across Europe and have become the most trusted name in our sector.



Key Responsibilities:

    Develop, maintain, and review detailed master construction programmes and project controls procedures for live projects.
     Prepare and present progress reviews and reports to senior management.
    Liaise with key stakeholders to review project progress, identify risks, and support proactive problem-solving.
    Establish and manage project schedule resource requirements across pre-construction, construction, and commissioning phases.
     Create and maintain progress reporting tools to track project goals and milestones.
     Provide performance updates and variance reports, identifying corrective actions as required.
     Represent the Planning function in client and subcontractor meetings, ensuring clear communication of schedule status and planning issues.
    Support account management and business development through strong client relationship management.
    Take ownership of assigned projects and support colleagues on other projects when required.
     Ensure planning practices align with company standards and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

    Maintain a weekly photographic project diary.
    Carry out all other duties required to successfully deliver the electrical package.

    Minimum 5+ years' relevant experience in the construction industry, ideally within a main contracting environment.
    Experience working on large-scale projects — preferably in data centres or high-tech industrial sectors.
    Strong understanding of construction methodologies, sequencing, and planning processes.
    Proficiency in Primavera P6 and/or Asta Powerproject; experience with BIM and digital construction tools is highly desirable.

     Strong analytical and logical thinking skills, with understanding of programming techniques and typical production rates.
    Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex planning information clearly.
    Ability to work to tight and sometimes challenging deadlines.
    Strong commercial awareness and understanding of contractual and project management principles.

Benefits:

    Opportunity to work on Europe's largest and most advanced data centre projects.
    Career growth and professional development in a fast-expanding sector.
    Competitive salary package.
    Supportive, dynamic, and collaborative team culture.

title: Finance Manager to Öhlins Group
description:
Do you want to take on a key role in a world-leading technology company with one of Sweden’s strongest brands in motorsport and premium vehicles? Do you thrive at the intersection of operational accounting, group reporting, and leadership? Then the role as Finance Manager at Öhlins could be the next step in your career.

Öhlins is in an exciting phase where the focus on business performance, cash flow, and financial governance is greater than ever. We are now looking for a Finance Manager who wants to help develop the finance function in an international environment.

Your Challenge

As Finance Manager, you will have overall responsibility for accounting and financial reporting across the Group. This is a central role within the organization, involving close collaboration with the CFO, management team, and colleagues in our international subsidiaries. You will be responsible for ensuring high quality in accounting, financial closings, and reporting while leading a high-performing finance team. The role combines hands-on operational work with leadership responsibilities, giving you the opportunity to influence processes, ways of working, and the continued development of the finance function.

The position is based at the headquarters in Upplands Väsby and reports directly to the CFO.

Your Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for:

    Responsible for all accounting and reporting, including monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements and external reports

title: Postdoctoral position in freshwater ecology and climate change
description:
Department of Forest Ecology and Management  

Project Description:

Climate change is increasing the frequency and intensity of droughts, floods, heatwaves, and storms. Small streams and their surrounding riparian forests are particularly vulnerable to these changes especially in managed forests where streams are already exposed to forestry pressures. Riparian buffers are the primary management tool for mitigating forestry impacts on streams, yet many buffers are poorly designed to maintain key ecological functions, particularly under a changing climate. The project addresses three interlinked questions: 1) how climate-driven extremes affect streams and riparian zones in managed forests; 2) which riparian buffer characteristics are most likely to enhance resistance and resilience to such extremes; and 3) how scientific knowledge on riparian buffers is translated into management guidelines and policy frameworks for climate adaptation.

This is a time-bound knowledge synthesis project that integrates scientific and applied evidence on climate-adapted riparian buffer management, focusing on boreal and hemi-boreal forest ecosystems. The project compiles and evaluates peer-reviewed literature, management guidelines, policy documents and/or available data to produce expected scientific deliverables.

About the position  

The postdoctoral fellow will be part of a collaborative project CLIMRIP (Climate-adapted riparian buffer management: a synthesis of boreal ecosystems and implications for practice) funded by Formas and supervised by principal investigator Associate Prof. Lenka Kuglerová. The project interdisciplinary team includes expertise in hydrology, ecology, freshwater science, microclimate, and social sciences. Support from the SLU library is secured. The postdoctoral fellow will also be part of a larger scientific network of the Krycklan Catchment Study.

The main responsibility of the postdoctoral fellow is to synthesise knowledge related to the three main project questions. Core tasks include:

    Designing and conducting systematic or rapid evidence reviews, meta-analyses, and/or evidence mapping of peer-reviewed literature on climate impacts on boreal streams and riparian zones, and on riparian buffer design for climate resilience.
    Compiling and evaluating management guidelines and policy documents to assess how scientific knowledge on riparian buffers is translated into forestry practice and policy.
    Leading the writing and submission of peer-reviewed publications based on this synthesis work as well as contributing to other scientific output (e.g., reports).
    Collaborating with the project team to integrate findings across disciplines and contribute to practical recommendations for climate-adapted forestry management.
    Presenting results at project meetings, conferences.

Your profile

We seek a talented and motivated postdoctoral researcher who has a strong background in natural sciences including freshwater sciences. The candidate should have a PhD in natural sciences (e.g., ecology, physical geography, forestry), ideally with specialization in freshwater ecology, limnology or similar fields.  We seek a candidate with experience in leading scientific publication process, and the ideal candidate must demonstrate ability to produce high-quality publications in English. Experience with reviews, meta-analyses or other knowledge synthesis methods are considered an advantage.

Other merits may include:

    Experience in boreal systems,
    Assessment of climate change impacts,
    Understanding of riparian buffer management,
    Ability to read Swedish,
    Participation in collaborative project teams

We are looking for a candidate with good personal skills, who is well-organized and structured, can work both independently and proactively, and has good communication skills.

As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates with a doctoral degree that is three years old at most.

About us  

The Postdoc. will be employed at The Department of Forest Ecology and Management. The department includes about 115 people of which 9 are professors. Our mission is to advance the understanding of forest ecosystems and how these should be managed today and in the future. For more information: http://www.slu.se/en/departments/forest-ecology-management/

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

title: Database Engineer
description:
Are you an experienced PostgreSQL specialist who enjoys working hands-on with complex database environments and large-scale migrations? We are currently looking for a Database Engineer to take a key role in an Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration within a large international company operating in the gaming and digital entertainment industry.

Job description:

As a Database Engineer, you will play a central role in the end-to-end migration of database services from Oracle to PostgreSQL. The assignment is highly technical and hands-on, while also requiring you to take ownership of the migration journey and act as an important link between the development teams and the database environment.

You will work closely with developers and database specialists to translate application requirements into practical and reliable PostgreSQL solutions. A key part of the role is to review and validate database schemas, configurations and application changes, ensuring that the migration is carried out accurately, efficiently and with minimal disruption to the existing platform.

The applications do not contain PL/SQL code, meaning no PL/SQL conversion is required as part of the assignment.

Key responsibilities:

    Lead and provide hands-on support throughout the Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration.
    Work closely with development teams and database specialists to ensure a smooth migration journey.
    Translate application requirements into practical PostgreSQL database solutions.
    Review and validate database schemas, configurations and application code changes.
    Ensure database performance, compatibility and accuracy throughout the migration.
    Support troubleshooting and technical decision-making related to PostgreSQL.
    Work with Liquibase for database schema versioning and migration.
    Document findings, learnings and best practices to support future database migrations.
    Contribute to a migration approach that minimizes downtime and disruption to business-critical services.

We are looking for someone who:

    Has extensive professional experience working as a PostgreSQL DBA, Database Engineer or PostgreSQL Developer.
    Has deep technical knowledge of PostgreSQL and is comfortable working hands-on with databases.
    Has previous experience from Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration projects.
    Has a good understanding of Oracle databases and Oracle-to-PostgreSQL datatype mappings.
    Has experience reviewing and working with database schemas, SQL, configurations and performance.
    Understands Liquibase and database schema versioning.
    Is comfortable working independently within an established migration framework.
    Has strong communication and collaboration skills and enjoys working closely with software development teams.
    Is proactive, structured and able to take technical ownership of complex migration activities.
    Is fluent in English, both spoken and written, as this is the primary working language.

It is considered an advantage if you have experience working with Java applications connected to PostgreSQL, distributed systems and event-driven architectures such as Kafka and/or Solace. Experience migrating high-traffic services with minimal downtime is also highly valuable. Knowledge of AI-assisted development workflows and tools such as Cursor, Claude or similar agent-based solutions is considered a plus.

Great emphasis will be placed on your ability to combine deep technical expertise with a collaborative mindset. We believe you are someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges while helping development teams move forward. You are comfortable taking initiative, working operationally and contributing both technical expertise and structure throughout the migration.
